4f177338559d.en: Harry (?) is a stranger born somewhere in the western part of our world. He was living a mundane life until he had a heart attack and dropped dead. He was on his way to becoming nothingness in his eternal rest, but suddenly at 1039 A.G. Paulin 14th, he was summoned. Now his memories of past life got jumbled. He doesn't even know who he truly is or what he is capable of, but that's not all of his woes, for his supposed new home does not feel familiar at all—surely, a long, rough journey is now ahead of him.
4f177338559d.t: 哈利（?）是一个出生在我们世界西方某处的陌生人。他一直过着平凡的生活，直到心脏病发作猝然倒地而亡。他本来正在永恒的安息中走向虚无，但在 1039 A.G. 保林 14日，他突然被召唤了。如今他对前世的记忆变得一团混乱。他甚至不知道自己到底是谁、能做什么，但这还不是他全部的烦恼，因为他所谓的新家感觉一点也不熟悉——显然，一段漫长而艰难的旅程正在等着他。

4f2794a7dee0.en: Likes and dislikes: likes her village, her friends and her family. Dislikes mess, especially at home.
4f2794a7dee0.t: 喜好与厌恶：喜欢她的村子、她的朋友和她的家人。不喜欢乱糟糟的，尤其是在家里。

4f9736f0f50d.en: Habits: personal, and can get handsy, but his personality makes it work, so most people don't feel invaded; moves around more than most, and likes to stand and walk; looks people in the eye with a sincere, warm smile.
4f9736f0f50d.t: 习惯：很亲切，可能会动手动脚，但他的性格让这一切都不显得冒犯，所以大多数人不会觉得被侵犯；比大多数人更爱走动，喜欢站着和走路；用真诚温暖的笑容看着别人的眼睛。

4fe188e79caf.en: Likes and dislikes: loves farming and everything to do with it, including the food that comes out of it.
4fe188e79caf.t: 喜好与厌恶：热爱农业和一切与之相关的东西，包括农业产出的食物。

4fe56595584d.en: Magi grew up with loving parents and would likely have become a historian, but the sudden disappearance of her father, Fernan, forced her to become an adventurer to pay off guild debts. She wants to find him, or at least his bow. She inherited her father's hunting talent, but she has narcolepsy and is rather distrustful of people. She always carries hunting gear in her bag, especially traps and camouflage for hiding.
4fe56595584d.t: 玛姬在充满爱的父母身边长大，原本很可能会成为一名历史学家，但她父亲费尔南的突然失踪，迫使她成为冒险者来偿还公会的债务。她想找到他，或者至少找到他的弓。她继承了父亲的狩猎天赋，但她有嗜睡症，而且对人相当不信任。她的包里总是带着狩猎装备，尤其是陷阱和用来藏身的伪装。

4feab708ff67.en: Strengths: sensitive; creative; harmonious and calm; peaceful; loving; hardworking; clean.
4feab708ff67.t: 优点：敏感；有创造力；与人和睦、沉着；平和；有爱心；勤劳；爱干净。

50004d39cc98.en: Habits: perceptive like Eiri, but handsier, like Itagiba; likes to be comfortable; an adulterous smirk.
50004d39cc98.t: 习惯：像艾莉一样敏锐，但更爱动手动脚，像伊塔吉巴；喜欢舒服；一副偷情般的坏笑。

503c9969afd1.en: Flaws: boastful; touchy; narcissistic; hotheaded; gullible; envious.
503c9969afd1.t: 缺点：爱吹嘘；敏感易怒；自恋；急躁；容易上当；爱嫉妒。

5040fc5f5626.en: Flaws: shy; selfish; hesitant; forgetful; doesn't like to travel; dependent.
5040fc5f5626.t: 缺点：害羞；自私；犹豫；健忘；不喜欢旅行；依赖性强。

50d11eb48c5c.en: Flaws: cowardly; dogmatic; calculating; self-indulgent; somewhat fragile; overcritical at times, since she overanalyzes some situations.
50d11eb48c5c.t: 缺点：胆小；教条；工于心计；放纵自己；有点脆弱；有时过于挑剔，因为她会过度分析某些情况。

5129031097da.en: Attracted to: a cougar. She likes handsome men, who just happen to be younger.
5129031097da.t: 喜欢的类型：熟女猎手。她喜欢帅气的男人，而他们恰好都更年轻。

5191f483a5db.en: Strengths: likes to get to the bottom of everything, leaving no stone unturned; detail-oriented; a sense of justice (his version of it: if he suspects you of something, he'll torture the information out of you); trusts his gut, sometimes too much, making on-the-fly decisions that go against the plan he just laid out.
5191f483a5db.t: 优点：喜欢把一切追根究底，不放过任何线索；注重细节；有正义感（是他自己版本的正义：如果他怀疑你什么，就会把情报从你身上拷问出来）；相信直觉，有时太相信了，会当场做出违背自己刚定下的计划的决定。

51a95cf2aff8.t: 太郎·米德·甘杜·斯特朗·莱格

522148320e4a.en: Ryo: a slim young man in a brown top and shorts with a long purple cape, hand on hip.
522148320e4a.t: 亮：一个身材瘦削的年轻男子，穿着棕色上衣和短裤，披着长长的紫色斗篷，一只手叉着腰。

5264a162cce9.en: Magi (1020 A.G. Asa 3rd) came from Blood and now wanders throughout the kingdoms after becoming a pearl adventurer. She knows her narcolepsy is the last trait someone in her position should have, but she has to find her father after his suspicious demise! Especially after the lies his supposed friends babbled to her family to soothe the pain. Plus, her family guild is being burdened by a fair amount of debt, so she has to help her mom keep things afloat and her young brother in school to have a better opportunity in life.
5264a162cce9.t: 玛姬（1020 A.G. 阿萨 3日）来自布拉德，成为珀尔级冒险者后，如今在各王国之间四处游历。她知道，嗜睡症是她这种处境的人最不该有的特质，但她必须在父亲可疑地离世后找到他！尤其是在他那些所谓的朋友对她家人编了一堆谎话来抚平伤痛之后。再说，她家的公会背负着相当多的债务，所以她必须帮妈妈维持生计，还要让年幼的弟弟继续上学，好让他将来有更好的机会。

5277f44850e2.en: Habits: relaxed posture, friendly in general; not touchy, but not distant either. Looks people in the eye with sincerity.
5277f44850e2.t: 习惯：姿态放松，总体很友好；不爱动手动脚，但也不疏远。会真诚地看着别人的眼睛。

52aca80c32c8.en: Intelligence: knows a fair amount for her age, and is always eager to learn more.
52aca80c32c8.t: 智力：以她的年纪来说懂得不少，而且总是渴望学得更多。

5318b8a526de.en: Born in Forway City to mixed-blood parents who had left the Gandew Kingdom and made their living in whatever jobs they could find, with little education but great physical strength. The discrimination and smugness of pure-blood Darfaries toward his mixed blood always rubbed him the wrong way. One day he signed a contract with a rich man without reading the fine print, and members of the rich man's family harassed him over it, which made him hate everyone even more. In time, he founded what is now known as the Blue Wozens with two other people, and struck back at the family.
5318b8a526de.t: 他生在福威城，父母是混血儿，离开了甘杜王国，靠能找到的任何工作谋生，没受过多少教育，但力气很大。纯血达尔法里斯对他混血身份的歧视和傲慢一直让他很不舒服。有一天，他没看细则就和一个有钱人签了合同，那个有钱人的家人因此骚扰他，这让他更加痛恨所有人。后来，他和另外两个人创立了如今所知的布卢沃增斯，向那个家族发起了反击。

53342c568668.en: Likes and dislikes: an Amethyst adventurer, picky about his quests. Loves makeup, looking good and matching accessories to his clothes. Loves blue. Hates fat Tolerideme people ("it's unbeauty"). Loves talking about himself, especially what he's done. Hates combat, and prefers verbal arguments.
53342c568668.t: 喜好与厌恶：阿米西斯特级冒险者，挑任务很挑剔。爱化妆、爱好看，爱用配饰搭配衣服。喜欢蓝色。讨厌胖胖的托勒里德梅人（“那是不美”）。爱谈论自己，尤其是自己做过的事。讨厌战斗，更喜欢口头争论。

540fd4630a6c.en: Habits: jumps into conversations to keep Laramy from getting screwed like no other; likes to put herself in front of people, especially standing up; loving and touchy with her family.
540fd4630a6c.t: 习惯：会插进谈话，以防拉勒米被人坑得无人能比；喜欢挡在别人前面，尤其是站着的时候；对家人充满爱、爱动手动脚。

544e78f6ae0c.en: Eiri: a blonde young woman in a blue hood and a blue-and-yellow ruffled dress.
544e78f6ae0c.t: 艾莉：一位戴着蓝色兜帽、身穿蓝黄色荷叶边连衣裙的金发年轻女子。

547bb8dcc42b.en: Habits: props herself against the wall for the real talks; gestures, with a big sister's condescending tone, but she means well; gets angry if people mess with her stuff.
547bb8dcc42b.t: 习惯：说正经话时会靠在墙上；带着大姐姐式居高临下的语气比手画脚，但她是好意；如果有人乱动她的东西，她会生气。

54f4ec39470a.en: He's very subservient to Neferteri and models himself on her: he keeps no logbook, holding his notes and reports in his head, rehearsed to give the Queen just the right amount of information without wasting her time. He doesn't play mind games and isn't the experimental type: when he acts, he knows the outcome from practice. Very autistic, he's stuck doing things a certain way (killing with the spike of his Stinger helmet, for example). Even in disguise, he gives himself away by how instantly ready to fight and how aware of his surroundings he is.
54f4ec39470a.t: 他对奈菲尔特丽极其顺从，并以她为榜样：他不记日志，把笔记和报告都记在脑子里，反复演练，好给王后恰到好处的信息量，不浪费她的时间。他不玩心理游戏，也不是爱尝试的类型：他行动时，靠练习就知道结果。他有很明显的自闭症特征，执着于用特定的方式做事（比如用他斯廷格头盔上的尖刺杀人）。即使伪装起来，他也会因为随时准备战斗、对周围环境高度警觉而暴露自己。

554a218b3d4c.en: Speech: lewd; friendly, but fair; can be aggressive when she wants to. Speaks in simple language, doesn't use names and often forgets them; says "c'mon" and "hmmm", in a high-pitched voice.
554a218b3d4c.t: 说话方式：淫荡；友好，但公平；想凶的时候也能很凶。说话用简单的词，不叫名字，还常常忘记名字；爱说“来嘛”和“嗯～”，声音很尖。

55dfa56bab10.en: Flaws: temperamental; changeable; contemptuous, intolerant and impatient when he gets temperamental; quick to act without really thinking things through.
55dfa56bab10.t: 缺点：喜怒无常；善变；一闹脾气就轻蔑、偏狭又不耐烦；不经思考就急于行动。

55f5a1813b63.en: Strengths: compassionate; a listener; thorough; responsible; objective; heroic; confident; capable; articulate; restrained about unnecessary fights; convinced of his morals.
55f5a1813b63.t: 优点：富有同情心；善于倾听；周全；有责任心；客观；英勇；自信；能干；口齿清晰；克制，不打不必要的架；坚信自己的道德。

562e86756595.en: Strengths: friendly; caring; mischievous; ecchi (especially when drunk); action-oriented; capable; charming; optimistic; "let it be"; self-important, especially if someone tries to compete; open-minded.
562e86756595.t: 优点：友好；体贴；调皮；色（尤其是喝醉的时候）；行动派；能干；有魅力；乐观；“顺其自然”；自命不凡，尤其是有人想和他竞争的时候；思想开放。

569a33e06695.en: Severino's family: a dark-haired woman in a cream dress, a small blond boy, and a long-haired blond man with a blade (marked with an arrow).
569a33e06695.t: 塞韦里诺一家：一个穿着米色连衣裙的黑发女人、一个金发小男孩，以及一个拿着刀刃的长发金发男人（用箭头标出）。

56b5a920c092.t: 玛姬·布拉德·布卢·弗劳尔·雷德·博恩

5700960f83c4.en: Likes and dislikes: prefers Sundeath to anything else. Hates humidity and cold. Loves Lolish, especially preserved in sugar.
5700960f83c4.t: 喜好与厌恶：比起任何地方都更喜欢桑德斯。讨厌潮湿和寒冷。爱吃洛利什，尤其是糖渍的。

5737e14d2481.t: 迈孔·克罗斯罗兹·布莱克·达夫

5789bca30109.en: Lofinghy (993 A.G Adrian 51th) is a well-known Forway General on the entire East Coast. The armor and general cap are a dead giveaway, yes, but many people will still recognize him when he is dressed in plain clothes. He was born and raised in the fish-smelling Sanbi Kingdom, but at the tender age of fifteen, he suddenly skipped town and went to Forway to grind away. It was an odd decision, but he knew that's where the money was. He was on the grind until he eventually rose to become an aquamarine captain at Forway. However, the more time passed, the more he longed for Sanbi Kingdom, its laid-back vibe, and tasty, homely meals. With more power, there's a greater ability to bend fate to your will, so he created an opportunity to move back to Sanbi while remaining a top dog. Now the Captain of the Forway embassy in Sanbi, he works—and drinks—closely with Sanbi Royals to push for better Sanbi policies. If you want to get cozy with him, make sure to buy a Purply Smart Lambic Beer, and say “I don’t agree with you” in something random he said before in public. Just do that and he will debate you for the rest of the day.
5789bca30109.t: 洛芬吉（993 A.G 阿德里安 51日）是整个东海岸都知名的福威将军。盔甲和将军帽确实一眼就能认出来，但就算他穿着便服，很多人还是能认出他。他在满是鱼腥味的桑比王国出生长大，但在十五岁那年，他突然离开家乡，去福威打拼。这是个奇怪的决定，但他知道钱在那儿。他一直埋头苦干，最终升为福威的阿夸马林级队长。然而，时间过得越久，他就越怀念桑比王国、那里悠闲的氛围和美味的家常饭菜。权力越大，就越有能力让命运顺从自己的意愿，所以他创造了一个机会，在保持高位的同时搬回桑比。如今作为福威驻桑比大使馆的队长，他与桑比王室密切合作——也密切地一起喝酒——推动更好的桑比政策。如果你想和他套近乎，一定要买一杯珀普利·斯马特·兰比克啤酒，然后针对他以前在公开场合说过的随便什么话说一句“我不同意你的看法”。只要这么做，他就会和你辩论一整天。

57a33f86a2e6.en: Intelligence: very smart with accounting and numbers in general, but her social skills took a hit. She also picked up cooking like a pro along the way.
57a33f86a2e6.t: 智力：在会计和数字方面非常聪明，但社交能力受到了影响。一路上她还学会了一手专业级的厨艺。

57e78f013527.en: Flaws: guarded; sometimes too eager to pull the trigger on deals; hurried; forgetful; foolish; innocent; neglectful.
57e78f013527.t: 缺点：戒备心强；有时太急于拍板做交易；毛躁；健忘；愚蠢；天真；疏忽。

57e82a65aa68.en: Likes and dislikes: loves meat, especially seared over coal with Tastyleaf sprinkled on top.
57e82a65aa68.t: 喜好与厌恶：爱吃肉，尤其是在炭火上烤、上面撒着泰斯蒂利夫的肉。

589419359f21.en: Born in Forway to a Sundeath mother and a well-off Wozefaries father. He grew up exploring the world's cuisines and came to love the diversity of food, which he explores in his restaurant, The Wood People Picker.
589419359f21.t: 他生在福威，母亲来自桑德斯，父亲是个家境不错的沃泽法里斯。他从小探索世界各地的美食，爱上了食物的多样性，并在他的餐馆伍德·皮普尔·皮克里探索这种多样性。

58b609247447.en: Speech: soft-spoken; asks questions, and goes back and forth on the meat of the matter.
58b609247447.t: 说话方式：说话轻柔；爱提问，在事情的关键上反复推敲。

5928096f8e8b.en: Alford (980 A.G Moacir 71th) is a sucker for anything farming related, so much so it landed him the Dirt King, also called Farm King, role when he was only twenty years old. He met his partner (Luny) when she began working as the new Courtroom Scientist ten years ago, getting fixated on her inventions and improvements in farming. But due to his narrow mind, or likely being in a sort of spectrum, any girl can effortlessly sweet talk him if they start blabbing about farming, leading him to still participates in orgies here and there in secret-ish, leading him on hot water now and then with Luny, and only her apparently since nobody else at Tolerideme cares what you so sexually as long as you take care of the children you make. Some faint rumors state Alford had a child already but refused to take care of it. Still, that rumor was created most likely to either light a fire under Luny’s butt to stop bitching and just have a child with him already or by someone interested in taking over Alford’s position.
5928096f8e8b.t: 阿尔福德（980 A.G 莫阿西尔 71日）对任何与农业相关的东西都毫无抵抗力，以至于他年仅二十岁就当上了泥土之王，也叫农业之王。十年前，当露妮开始担任新任宫廷科学家时，他认识了自己的伴侣（露妮），迷上了她在农业方面的发明和改进。但由于他心思单纯，或者很可能处于某种谱系上，任何女孩只要开始滔滔不绝地谈论农业，就能毫不费力地用甜言蜜语哄住他，这导致他至今仍然半偷偷摸摸地时不时参加群交，也时不时因此和露妮闹得不可开交——显然只有露妮在意，因为在托勒里德梅，只要你照顾好自己生的孩子，没人在乎你的性生活。有一些隐约的传言说，阿尔福德已经有过一个孩子，但拒绝抚养。不过，这个传言很可能是有人编出来的，要么是为了催一催露妮，让她别再抱怨，赶紧和他生个孩子，要么是某个想取代阿尔福德位置的人。

59565f352d3a.en: Speech: lots of "could", "would", "maybe", "hmm" and "ahh"; tries not to be pushy; forgets names, so he tends not to use them.
59565f352d3a.t: 说话方式：大量使用“可以”“会”“也许”“嗯”和“啊”；尽量不强人所难；记不住名字，所以往往不叫名字。

596718377069.en: Attracted to: a predator who targets children.
596718377069.t: 喜欢的类型：一个以儿童为目标的掠食者。

5968f4b60fde.en: Attracted to: an independent, beautiful woman who doesn't want him just because he is (or was going to be) King of Sanbi.
5968f4b60fde.t: 喜欢的类型：一个独立、美丽的女人，不是只因为他是（或者将会是）桑比国王才想要他。

597020761173.en: Likes and dislikes: likes looking pretty, and loves teasing men to bend them to her will. Likes Lonllow and cute Bruntos, and bonded with a girly one.
597020761173.t: 喜好与厌恶：喜欢打扮得漂漂亮亮，爱撩男人让他们对她言听计从。喜欢朗洛和可爱的布伦托斯，还和一只少女心的布伦托斯建立了感情。

599eed0ff3ef.en: Intelligence: a good business sense, but his daring side sometimes gets the better of him.
599eed0ff3ef.t: 智力：很有生意头脑，但他大胆的一面有时会占上风。

5acc33e35477.en: Attracted to: a lady who shares his passion for farming; size doesn't really matter.
5acc33e35477.t: 喜欢的类型：和他一样热爱农业的女士；体型其实无所谓。

5b18a45a9f04.en: Bata (995 A.G. Moacir 30th) is the identical twin brother of Anpu. Which one is which? Nobody knows, and that’s on purpose! These two want to become a single entity so badly they are always on nari gels to look perfectly alike. They even developed a synchronicity interface through eyesight that allows them to predict what each other is thinking nearly instinctively. That is unless a monkey wrench is thrown in their act, like Neferteri showing up or you asking a question that scratches the individualism laying dormant underneath it all. Will they become the next leaders of Sundeath? Eventually, yes, but Gamal does not bulge from the role until they get their act together. However, the Pharaohs guild has no other twin girls for marriage, plus ignoring the rumors that these two brothers only love themselves is hard to do when you see them riding a single Egua together, often galloping.
5b18a45a9f04.t: 巴塔（995 A.G. 莫阿西尔 30日）是安普的同卵双胞胎兄弟。哪个是哪个？没人知道，而且这是故意的！这两人太想合为一体了，以至于他们总是在用纳里凝胶，好让自己看起来完全一样。他们甚至开发出了一种通过视觉实现的同步界面，让他们几乎能本能地预测对方在想什么。除非有人给他们的表演捣乱，比如奈菲尔特丽出现了，或者你问了一个触及潜藏在这一切之下的个人主义的问题。他们会成为桑德斯的下一任领袖吗？最终会的，但在他们把自己的事搞定之前，贾迈勒不会让出这个位置。然而，法老斯公会没有别的双胞胎女孩可以结婚，再说，当你看到这两兄弟一起骑着一匹埃瓜、还常常疾驰而过时，很难不去理会那些说他们只爱自己的传言。

5b431e21da7d.en: Jimmie (997 A.G. Moacir 73th) love for life is split between booze and fat poontang, known for his decisive attitude, a great network of people, reeking of booze at all timehunks, and often being found in an orgy pile of big chicks warming him up. All, some more necessary than others, are characteristics of the great Alcohol King, more commonly called Booze King. His unique recipe is still one of the best things ever invented out of Tolerideme, being the sole reason for lifting his family farm out of obscurity and into riches and even leadership. Someday, those riches will surely be a point of contention between the growing number of kids.
5b431e21da7d.t: 吉米（997 A.G. 莫阿西尔 73日）对生活的热爱一半给了酒，一半给了胖妞，他以果断的态度、广阔的人脉、任何 timehunk 都满身酒气，以及常常被人发现躺在一堆给他取暖的大块头姑娘中间而闻名。这些——有些比另一些更必要——都是伟大的酒精之王（更常被称为酒鬼之王）的特征。他独特的配方至今仍是托勒里德梅有史以来最好的发明之一，正是它让他家的农场从默默无闻走向富裕，甚至获得了领导地位。总有一天，这些财富肯定会在越来越多的孩子之间引起争端。

5b9d41b0e491.en: Intelligence: a really good memory for following directions, but he needs them step by step: almost robotic, he gets lost as soon as anything is left open.
5b9d41b0e491.t: 智力：照着指示做事的记性非常好，但他需要一步一步的指示：几乎像个机器人，只要有任何没说清楚的地方他就会迷失。

5c72b108f095.en: Speech: quick to agree or disagree and move on as soon as he has heard the other person out. His voice is tired, raspy and detached, even though his words show he listened to every word.
5c72b108f095.t: 说话方式：听完对方的话后，很快表示同意或反对，然后就转向下一件事。他的声音疲惫、沙哑、冷淡，尽管他的话表明他每个字都听进去了。

5e172fd7f2e2.en: Attracted to: tall, handsome human men who are kind to her and treat her well; she has that prince-like wish.
5e172fd7f2e2.t: 喜欢的类型：高大、帅气、对她好、善待她的人类男人；她怀着那种盼望王子的心愿。

5e557ae6c80f.t: 明美·布拉德·布卢·弗劳尔·雷德·博恩

5e7e3ba6266e.en: Habits: avoids eye contact; keeps her hands to herself; helps those she feels neutral about. If she notices someone might have feelings for her, her head implodes from sheer embarrassment, imagining the wedding.
5e7e3ba6266e.t: 习惯：避免眼神接触；手不乱碰；会帮助她感觉中立的人。如果她察觉到有人可能对她有意思，她的脑袋就会因为极度害羞而当场爆炸，开始想象婚礼。

5e836ce27b30.en: Likes and dislikes: loves her family, and is trying to bring them all to live in Forway, though she doesn't make enough yet; for now, she can at least save for emergencies. Loves flowers and the scent they give off when they bloom. Loves Laura for the opportunity she gave her.
5e836ce27b30.t: 喜好与厌恶：爱她的家人，正努力把他们全都接到福威来住，不过她赚的钱还不够；目前她至少可以存点钱以备不时之需。爱花，爱花开时散发的香气。爱劳拉给了她机会。

5ea7032fbbbf.en: Aurora (988 A.G. Asa 31st) is an older woman that has experienced many things in life but has remained positive through it all. One of those experiences coerced her to call Sanbi Kingdom home instead. However, she is now a maid at the Sanbi castle which is a coveted position, so life always works itself out in the end. And no, she won't change her badge to say she's from Sanbi because Tolerideme is where most of her memories and soul are.
5ea7032fbbbf.t: 奥萝拉（988 A.G. 阿萨 31日）是一位年纪较大的女人，经历过人生中的许多事情，但始终保持着乐观。其中一段经历迫使她把桑比王国当成了家。不过，她现在是桑比城堡的女仆，这可是个令人垂涎的职位，所以生活最终总会有个好结果。还有，不，她不会把身份牌改成桑比人，因为托勒里德梅才是她大部分回忆和灵魂所在的地方。

5eb52913275c.en: To her surprise, that same adventurer, Fernan, passed by her again one day and asked how she was doing. She said she'd followed his advice, and he giddily asked if he could give her another piece of advice: go on a date with him! They grew closer, and Magi and her little brother were born. Akemi knows a fair amount of history, but her real interest lies in the occult and forbidden knowledge. Her clothes show some wear, since she's saving every ball she can for her son's specialty school.
5eb52913275c.t: 让她惊讶的是，有一天同一位冒险者费尔南又从她身边经过，问她过得怎么样。她说她听了他的建议，他兴奋地问能不能再给她一个建议：和他约会！他们越走越近，后来有了玛姬和她的弟弟。明美懂不少历史，但她真正的兴趣在于神秘学和禁忌知识。她的衣服有些旧了，因为她把能攒的每一个球都存起来给儿子上专门学校。

5ef54db2ea68.en: Likes and dislikes: likes people with power. Doesn't like dealing with petty things, especially petty people.
5ef54db2ea68.t: 喜好与厌恶：喜欢有权势的人。不喜欢处理琐碎的事，尤其是琐碎的人。

5f277725658c.en: Likes and dislikes: hates people above him, or anyone who makes a point of being above him. Likes most food, except what clearly tastes funky, and especially raw things.
5f277725658c.t: 喜好与厌恶：讨厌地位比他高的人，或者故意要压他一头的人。大多数食物都爱吃，除了味道明显怪怪的东西，尤其是生的东西。

5f9bd3c88bab.en: Sinoi: an old gray-haired man with a pipe, wearing a blue patterned vest and trousers.
5f9bd3c88bab.t: 西诺伊：一个叼着烟斗的灰发老人，穿着蓝色花纹背心和长裤。

5fe114268f75.en: Likes and dislikes: loves food, and being with her mother to copy her behavior. Hates Nina, but has to put up with her, or she'd get in trouble.
5fe114268f75.t: 喜好与厌恶：爱吃东西，爱跟着妈妈模仿她的举止。讨厌妮娜，但不得不忍着她，否则她就会惹上麻烦。

5ff1d73e0dc5.t: 布兰迪·托勒里德梅·胡普·阿斯

600aa1b5666e.en: Nooru (919 A.G. Adrian 19th) is, without a doubt, the most friendly King of Gandew in the books. It would be fair to expect a high approval rate from his citizens, but that only applies to support from other kingdoms. Some people within his monarchy suspect his overly warm relationships with non-Darfaries folks extend as far as frolicking with them too.
600aa1b5666e.t: 努鲁（919 A.G. 阿德里安 19日）毫无疑问是史书上最友好的甘杜国王。人们会以为他在国民中的支持率很高，但那只适用于其他王国的支持。他君主制内部的一些人怀疑，他与非达尔法里斯人过于亲密的关系，甚至延伸到了和他们鬼混的地步。

60b9da50fa3c.en: Honati's family portrait for Arc 2: a gray-haired man, a pink-haired girl and an orange-haired woman (marked with an arrow).
60b9da50fa3c.t: 霍娜蒂第 2 弧的全家福：一个灰发男人、一个粉发女孩和一个橙发女人（用箭头标出）。

60c9d053a89e.en: Habits: an air of superiority; duck face; bitchy face; likes to flaunt it.
60c9d053a89e.t: 习惯：一副高人一等的样子；嘟嘴；臭脸；喜欢炫耀。

610a4ffddaea.t: 喜欢的类型：依赖人、有安全感的男人。

61d9410b7746.en: Strengths: a skilled communicator; sociable; clever; resourceful (with connections); friendly; self-confident; placid, controlling her emotions and hiding her true intentions.
61d9410b7746.t: 优点：沟通高手；善于社交；聪明；足智多谋（靠人脉）；友好；自信；沉着，能控制情绪、隐藏真实意图。

61e8fbe2533c.en: Intelligence: a man set in his ways: preceptive, and willing to lay down how things have to be. He can't read, but he can certainly read people who try to outwit him. A talented logger.
61e8fbe2533c.t: 智力：一个墨守成规的男人：爱立规矩，乐于说明事情必须怎么做。他不识字，但他绝对能看穿想耍他的人。是个有天赋的伐木工。

62198a153725.en: Intelligence: a quick learner, eager to understand the new job and how everyone and everything in the castle works.
62198a153725.t: 智力：学得快，渴望了解这份新工作，以及城堡里每个人、每件事是怎么运作的。

623697aed885.en: Flaws: mute (completely); dull; tense; boring; slight OCD issues; jealous; avoids fights.
623697aed885.t: 缺点：（完全）沉默；无趣；紧绷；乏味；有轻微的强迫症问题；爱嫉妒；回避打斗。

62504dd2f6f2.en: Flaws: narcissistic; looks calm, but his emotions drive him to figure things out without caring about others; careless of other people's feelings even while polite: his politeness is cold rather than sincere.
62504dd2f6f2.t: 缺点：自恋；看起来很冷静，但情绪驱使他不顾他人地把事情搞清楚；即使有礼貌，也不在乎别人的感受：他的礼貌是冷冰冰的，而不是真诚的。

625a1c633e6f.t: 种族：混血（人类和达尔法里斯）。

6292091fa675.en: Flaws: bitchy; rude; sees others as beneath her; gullible, especially when her ego is inflated.
6292091fa675.t: 缺点：刻薄；粗鲁；把别人看得低她一等；容易上当，尤其是在她自我膨胀的时候。

62ac4dba37f2.en: Born and raised north of Tolerideme, the daughter of traders, Laramy and Honati. She traveled a lot with them, picking up information about the world, and learned to read on the road, though she never went to school.
62ac4dba37f2.t: 她在托勒里德梅以北出生长大，是商人拉勒米和霍娜蒂的女儿。她经常和他们一起旅行，了解了很多关于世界的信息，还在路上学会了识字，虽然她从没上过学。

639a0f7f95cc.en: Speech: an aggressive, impatient tone; demanding, and belligerent when someone doesn't follow his plan 100%.
639a0f7f95cc.t: 说话方式：语气咄咄逼人、不耐烦；要求苛刻，有人没有百分之百按他的计划来时就变得好斗。

63aec8554ae9.en: Speech: he doesn't really start things, but goes along with whatever his wife comes up with.
63aec8554ae9.t: 说话方式：他不太会主动开启话题，而是顺着妻子的想法走。

63c70da7719c.en: Race: human, with Wozefaries (a higher percentage than usual).
63c70da7719c.t: 种族：人类，带有沃泽法里斯血统（比例比一般人高）。

6408c7385256.en: Automatic behaviors: she sometimes falls asleep while eating without even realizing it.
6408c7385256.t: 自动行为：她有时吃着饭就睡着了，自己都没意识到。

6431c228696e.en: A bit sassy and straightforward, like Itagiba: she's his illegitimate child, after all. She has no idea, and her mother, now dead, didn't know who the father was; it happened while Itagiba was exploring the world under a fake name. With no family, she forged her own path, and is now an adventurer who stumbles from party to party, complaining until each one disbands and she has to find another. Her big bust comes from sigil rings, though she refuses to admit it.
6431c228696e.t: 有点毒舌、直来直去，就像伊塔吉巴：毕竟她是他的私生女。她对此一无所知，而她已故的母亲也不知道父亲是谁；那是伊塔吉巴用假名周游世界时发生的事。没有家人，她自己闯出了一条路，现在是个在各个队伍之间跌跌撞撞的冒险者，一路抱怨，直到每个队伍都解散，她又得去找下一个。她的大胸是靠西吉尔环弄出来的，尽管她拒绝承认。

645b7d5b6ddf.en: Speech: confrontational and provocative; straight to the point.
645b7d5b6ddf.t: 说话方式：爱对抗、爱挑衅；开门见山。

64b909b26f94.en: Born in Sundeath and raised in one of the Pharaoh's servant families, she crossed paths with Neferteri on one of her visits and decided to follow her instead. She has worked in Sanbi ever since. Not an adventurer.
64b909b26f94.t: 她在桑德斯出生，在法老的一个仆人家族中长大，在奈菲尔特丽的一次来访中和她相遇，决定转而追随她。从那以后她一直在桑比工作。不是冒险者。

64e4ffd39005.en: Intelligence: above average; she knows a lot about history, fauna and flora. She strives to be independent, after all.
64e4ffd39005.t: 智力：高于平均水平；她对历史、动物和植物懂得很多。毕竟她努力想要独立。

65b7f41b6d44.en: Hiromi: a giant, muscular warrior in green-and-red armor with a fur collar, holding a spear, with a shield and scythe-spear beside him.
65b7f41b6d44.t: 弘美：一位身穿带毛皮领子的绿红色盔甲、肌肉发达的巨人战士，手持长矛，身旁放着盾牌和镰枪。

65fccea83c08.en: Strengths: secretive; harmonious; curious; organized; compassionate; gentle; open-minded; cool as a cucumber; doesn't let other people's status affect him.
65fccea83c08.t: 优点：守口如瓶；与人和睦；好奇；有条理；富有同情心；温和；思想开放；冷静得像根黄瓜；不受别人地位的影响。

665c1e4f16f7.en: Speech: "Sure, Gabiro." Somewhat monotone. He goes along, and sincerely asks just enough to get the ball rolling and do his job, but no more than he needs, since he might not remember it anyway.
665c1e4f16f7.t: 说话方式：“好的，加比罗。”有点单调。他随大流，真诚地问刚好足够的问题，让事情动起来、完成他的工作，但不会多问，因为反正他可能也记不住。

6664c48d06aa.en: Skills: a custom interface that enhances his hands for burrowing, learned from rodents; memory sharing (hands on someone's head, clawing in), an interface he got from Gabiro's manipulation.
6664c48d06aa.t: 技能：一个从啮齿动物那里学来的定制界面，能强化他的双手用来挖洞；记忆分享（把手放在别人头上、用爪子抓进去），这是他从加比罗的操纵中得到的界面。

6670d7f6a604.en: Attracted to: outwardly, a twin woman able to serve him and his brother; inwardly, his brother.
6670d7f6a604.t: 喜欢的类型：表面上是一个能侍奉他和他兄弟的双胞胎女人；内心里是他的兄弟。

6689407d78d8.en: Speech: harsh in some of his analyses, especially to avoid blood and guts; judgy, especially about Magi's adventuring.
6689407d78d8.t: 说话方式：有些分析很尖刻，尤其是为了避开血腥场面；爱评判，尤其是对玛姬的冒险。

66a74d148b73.en: Perderhora (?) is an unknown person or a passive beast. The jury is still out because even catching a glimpse of him nowadays is rare. Like a scaredy cat, he avoids contact at all costs. If you see a pair of feet sticking out of the ground as you hike around deep in the forests northwest of Forway, then you likely spotted a dead person disposed of by a gang or him sleeping in a burrow. Either way, better leave him be as the few people who still know him, or more likely know of him from hearing or reading recorded history, is that he was a famous attraction of Manhia’s Crazy Circus. Focus on “was” because a group of members from Pussy Power attacked the caravan as it was passing near Dealtacross.
66a74d148b73.t: 佩尔德奥拉（?）是一个身份不明的人，或者是一头被动的魔兽。目前还没有定论，因为如今就连瞥见他一眼都很罕见。他像只胆小的猫一样，不惜一切代价避免接触。如果你在福威西北的深林中远足时看到一双脚从地里伸出来，那你很可能是发现了一具被帮派处理掉的尸体，或者是他睡在洞穴里。不管怎样，最好别去打扰他，因为少数仍然认识他——或者更可能是通过听说或阅读史料而知道他——的人说，他曾是曼希娅疯狂马戏团的著名招牌。重点在“曾是”，因为普西帕瓦的一群成员在马戏团车队经过迪尔塔克罗斯附近时袭击了它。

66c985c38b06.en: Speech: relaxed, like a father two beers in. Playful with his words, but not with profanity. He points out flaws in what others say, but with a counterpoint, so he doesn't come off as an asshole.
66c985c38b06.t: 说话方式：放松，就像喝了两杯啤酒的老爸。言语俏皮，但不爆粗口。他会指出别人话里的漏洞，但会同时给出一个反驳，免得显得像个混蛋。

66ddbac338c3.en: Perderhora: a pale, long-limbed creature hanging upside down with bloody hands, with a hand close-up and a figure lying in a cave.
66ddbac338c3.t: 佩尔德奥拉：一个苍白、四肢细长的生物，倒挂着，双手沾满鲜血，附有手的特写和一个躺在洞穴里的身影。

672eb031b89a.t: 喜欢的类型：长头发的沃泽法里斯。

674440fbfe4a.en: Fascinated by: girls, or other very effeminate boys.
674440fbfe4a.t: 着迷于：女孩，或者其他非常女性化的男孩。

67d15d612638.t: 缺点：犹豫；健忘；内敛；依赖性强。

67e30374431d.en: Intelligence: still wet behind the ears, with tons to learn working under Kiko, and can't quite manage on his own yet. A bit dumb, in other words.
67e30374431d.t: 智力：还是个毛头小子，在基科手下工作还有大量东西要学，还不太能独当一面。换句话说，有点傻。

680175cd12b2.en: Attracted to: courtesans. He has trouble keeping long-term relationships.
680175cd12b2.t: 喜欢的类型：交际花。他很难维持长期关系。

683ad8a85ab9.en: Intelligence: as smart as Eiri; perceptive of context, and knows what to say.
683ad8a85ab9.t: 智力：和艾莉一样聪明；能洞察情境，知道该说什么。

684b95e240e9.en: He grew up in a village where he was almost culled. His mother fled with him, but she was killed by bandits, and the kid found his way to a village where he became the village pet, of sorts. Word spread, and Kiko eventually brought him under the Half-Cruro guild's care. Zico still visits that village every so often to say hi.
684b95e240e9.t: 他在一个村子里长大，在那里差点被淘汰。他母亲带着他逃走了，但她被强盗杀死了，这个孩子自己找到了一个村子，在那里成了某种意义上的村宠。消息传开了，基科最终把他收进了哈夫克鲁罗公会照顾。济科至今还会时不时回那个村子打个招呼。

688f8d08c8f9.en: Likes and dislikes: fine dining and drinks; loves fancy fruity drinks. Hates being mistaken for a Toleridemian, yet loves being big, since it gives him a sense of a barrier between himself and others (not that he's aware of it): food as a source of security and feeling good. For some reason, he doesn't like thirty-smalladi-long subs.
688f8d08c8f9.t: 喜好与厌恶：美食和美酒；爱喝花哨的果味饮料。讨厌被误认为是托勒里德梅人，却又爱自己块头大，因为这给他一种和别人之间隔着一道屏障的感觉（虽然他自己没意识到）：食物是安全感和好心情的来源。不知为何，他不喜欢三十斯莫拉迪长的潜艇三明治。

689a3c25dd3c.en: He grew up in Gandew as your usual Gandew-proud Darfaries, until a booze-filled dungeon party on his twentieth birthday ended in mystery, and he lost his parents and friends in one fell swoop: they went too deep and got lost. Separated from his parents, he found his way back, but couldn't recover their bodies to bring them back from the dead. He stumbled through life, through many hardships mostly brought on by his own state of mind: drugs, alcohol, living in the slums, begging and more. He got a new chance at life when a human courtesan he slept with gave birth to a child, Takeo. With a mouth to feed, he joined the Tea-Drinkers guild, and found himself a family.
689a3c25dd3c.t: 他在甘杜长大，是个典型的以甘杜为傲的达尔法里斯，直到二十岁生日那天一场灌满了酒的地下城派对以一个谜团告终，他一下子失去了父母和朋友：他们走得太深，迷了路。和父母失散后，他自己找回了路，却没能找回他们的尸体把他们复活。此后他跌跌撞撞地过日子，经历了许多苦难，大多是他自己的心态造成的：毒品、酒精、住贫民窟、乞讨等等。当一个和他睡过的人类交际花生下一个孩子武雄时，他得到了重新开始的机会。有了一张要喂的嘴，他加入了蒂·德林克斯公会，为自己找到了一个家。

68a721122b1f.en: Flaws: self-indulgent; insecure; shameless; predatory; doesn't think things through.
68a721122b1f.t: 缺点：放纵自己；没有安全感；不知羞耻；掠夺成性；做事不经大脑。

68d82295bd31.en: Strengths: a sweet persona; very caring; attentive; charming in her own way; grandmotherly, so to speak.
68d82295bd31.t: 优点：甜美的人设；非常体贴；细心；有她自己的魅力；可以说很有奶奶风范。

69a799c9edef.en: The Stinger: a figure in spiked golden armor with a horned golden helmet that hides the face.
69a799c9edef.t: 斯廷格：一个身穿带尖刺的金色盔甲、戴着遮住脸的金色角盔的身影。

69d2df1c9f66.en: Itagiba kept wanting a prince, and so Eori came into this world. She inherited a far more feminine appeal than her two older sisters, so her mother pressured her a bit to behave more like a princess. That bottled up some inner demons that can still come out at times, and thanks to Eiri, they became a cross between lewdness and anger. Growing up, she also took an interest in dissecting and studying animals, then began making nari gels, though finding test subjects without creating a fuss got harder. Her mother supported that side of her by having her do the non-princess stuff far from the public eye.
69d2df1c9f66.t: 伊塔吉巴一直想要一个王子，于是埃奥丽来到了这个世界。她比两个姐姐继承了多得多的女性魅力，所以她母亲给了她一些压力，让她表现得更像个公主。这让她压抑了一些内心的恶魔，它们至今仍不时冒出来，而多亏了艾莉，它们变成了淫荡和愤怒的混合体。长大过程中，她还对解剖和研究动物产生了兴趣，后来开始做纳里凝胶，不过要在不惹出乱子的情况下找到试验对象越来越难了。她母亲支持她这一面，让她远离公众视线去做那些不像公主做的事。

69e2552aa968.t: 喜欢的类型：少女心的沃泽法里斯。

69ff0ae79559.en: Speech: polite, distant and elegant; a calm, somewhat monotone voice, like her movements.
69ff0ae79559.t: 说话方式：礼貌、疏远、优雅；声音平静，有点单调，就像她的动作一样。

6a6da31b7476.en: Wilson (1019 A.G. Moacir 19th) is definitive proof that humans don't need a brain to survive, despite Marcus proving that wrong time after time whenever he cracks Wilson's skull open. Maybe he just refuses to use it? More than once, he opened his mouth to a guard and told him who he was and that he had fun being a bandit! And that's not the worst part either; once he showed the guard an item he had stolen and pointed to the post asking to find it with a burst of dumb laughter as if he was bragging about it to a long-time friend. Needless to say, Marcus split his head open after they skipped town. At least he seems to be good with the bow, or it's all because of the shiny bow he carries around like a conjoined twin.
6a6da31b7476.t: 威尔逊（1019 A.G. 莫阿西尔 19日）是人类不需要大脑也能活下去的铁证，尽管马库斯每次把威尔逊的脑壳敲开时都一再证明了这是错的。也许他只是拒绝用脑子？不止一次，他对卫兵开口，告诉对方自己是谁，还说当强盗很好玩！而这还不是最糟的；有一次他给卫兵看了一件他偷来的东西，指着告示要对方去找，然后爆发出一阵傻笑，就好像在跟一个老朋友炫耀似的。不用说，他们溜出城后，马库斯把他的脑袋劈开了。至少他的弓术似乎不错，或者这全都要归功于他像连体婴一样随身带着的那把闪亮的弓。

6b012530d12a.en: Speech: "Ah'wi'do" instead of "All right, will do"; yawns a lot. He doesn't ask questions or follow up, can get awkward, and isn't very communicative.
6b012530d12a.t: 说话方式：说“好嘞得嘞”而不是“好的，会办的”；经常打哈欠。他不问问题，也不跟进，可能会尴尬，不太善于沟通。

6b58deb1fb8a.en: Born to Darfaries parents who threw her off the Goodbye Cliff, she was rescued by Flatland. She and Mimi lived a simple life working for the town and its taverns, until they met Yosuke on his travels. Mimi bonded with him, so Hanako came along, and now they work together as a family. Hanako and Mimi aren't related by blood: both were thrown off the Goodbye Cliff, and they became sisters through circumstance. No one knows who their parents are, except the parents themselves.
6b58deb1fb8a.t: 她生于达尔法里斯父母，被他们扔下了再见悬崖，后被弗拉特兰救下。她和咪咪过着简单的生活，在镇上和酒馆里打工，直到她们在洋介旅行时遇见了他。咪咪和他建立了感情，于是花子也跟了过来，现在她们像一家人一样一起工作。花子和咪咪没有血缘关系：两人都被扔下了再见悬崖，因为境遇而成了姐妹。没人知道她们的父母是谁，除了父母自己。

6ba1316dc692.en: Speech: short and sweet. She strips the emotions out and leaves the cold, hard facts; doesn't use interjections, and says "you", "he" and "she" far more than "I". She pries for information and listens; her questions are like arrows into a Bagarisa's heart. Her "hmm, hmm" murmurs can go either way.
6ba1316dc692.t: 说话方式：简短扼要。她把情绪剥掉，只留下冷冰冰的事实；不用感叹词，说“你”“他”和“她”远比说“我”多。她会刺探信息并倾听；她的问题就像射进巴加里萨心脏的箭。她那“嗯，嗯”的低声回应可好可坏。

6c25a839bb09.en: Zico (1023 A.G. Asa 69th) works for Kiko or is perhaps an assistant to him. He's like the village dog, walking about Sanbi every single day, grunting away something akin to words as he scribbles away on his journal to communicate with anyone willing to give him an ear. Some say you haven't visited Sanbi until you have spotted and said hi to Zico.
6c25a839bb09.t: 济科（1023 A.G. 阿萨 69日）为基科工作，或者也许是他的助手。他就像村里的狗，每天都在桑比四处溜达，一边在日记本上涂涂写写，一边嘟囔着某种类似词语的声音，和任何愿意听他说话的人交流。有人说，没见过济科、没跟他打过招呼，就不算来过桑比。

6c386279f205.t: 缺点：漠不关心；放纵自己；自恋；没有魅力。

6d2a961cf658.t: 喜欢的类型：丰满的克鲁罗女孩。

6e049dba8332.en: Speech: resolute and straight to the point, breaking his sentences up; the drunker he gets, the longer the pauses, until he stops talking altogether. He's willing to fight with words, and makes sure your morals line up with his: sharp-toothed, cutting through the bullshit.
6e049dba8332.t: 说话方式：坚定、开门见山，把句子拆开说；喝得越醉，停顿越长，直到完全不说话。他愿意用言语交锋，并确保你的道德观和他的一致：牙尖嘴利，一针见血地戳穿胡扯。

6e1ef6f8a81a.en: Intelligence: emotionally intelligent, but never speaks up.
6e1ef6f8a81a.t: 智力：情商高，但从不开口表达。

6eac3685d9fe.en: Likes and dislikes: his mother's milk, Domar barley, baby food.
6eac3685d9fe.t: 喜好与厌恶：他妈妈的奶、多马尔大麦、婴儿食品。

6f3d37b8b663.en: Brandi (1039 A.G. Asa 69th) is the newest member of the Whoop-Ass guild and likely not the last. Some people are already betting whether he will turn out closer to Ariana or Amelia.
6f3d37b8b663.t: 布兰迪（1039 A.G. 阿萨 69日）是胡普·阿斯公会最新的成员，而且很可能不是最后一个。有些人已经在打赌他最终会更像阿丽亚娜还是阿米莉娅。

6fbb729e8ce1.en: Born in Endlessfog into a large Buhraies family (with no formal guild) that ran one of the smaller Lonllow farms, known as the Horane farm. They kept to themselves and only talked to others to trade goods; some believed they were an offshoot of the Triangle cult or something like it. The truth: the family descended from a Buhraies couple who fled to Endlessfog instead of the desert, choosing to hide rather than fight the humans. By the time humans settled Endlessfog more heavily and discovered them, the settlers either didn't care, or were fleeing the human wars themselves.
6fbb729e8ce1.t: 他生在恩德莱斯福格一个布莱斯大家族（没有正式公会），这个家族经营着一个较小的朗洛农场，人称霍兰农场。他们不和外人来往，只为交易货物才和别人说话；有些人认为他们是特赖安格尔邪教或类似组织的分支。真相是：这个家族是一对布莱斯夫妇的后代，他们逃到了恩德莱斯福格而不是沙漠，选择躲起来，而不是和人类作战。等到人类更大规模地定居恩德莱斯福格、发现他们时，那些定居者要么不在乎，要么自己也在逃离人类的战争。

701968680f85.en: Speech: pauses a lot; noncommittal, except when it comes to helping, especially his parents. Avoids names, since he forgets them.
701968680f85.t: 说话方式：停顿很多；不置可否，除非是帮忙的事，尤其是帮他父母。避免叫名字，因为他记不住。

708ad17b4eab.en: Habits: ignores personal space; disarms men with cuteness and playfulness; tsundere; "tsk".
708ad17b4eab.t: 习惯：无视个人空间；用可爱和俏皮让男人卸下防备；傲娇；“啧”。

70f5073b4bad.en: At 20, passing through Sundeath, he met his destiny: Neferteri, the most exotic and beautiful girl he had ever seen. They had some trouble, since she was to become the next Pharaoh, but she chose to flee it all and live in Sanbi with her true love. He became king in 1015 A.G. He loves his daughters all equally, but wishes he'd had at least one prince. He wears a white cape, with no beard, maybe fine stubble.
70f5073b4bad.t: 二十岁那年，他路过桑德斯，遇到了自己的命运：奈菲尔特丽，他见过的最有异国情调、最美的女孩。他们遇到了些麻烦，因为她要成为下一任法老，但她选择抛下一切，和她的真爱一起住到桑比。他在 1015 A.G. 成为国王。他平等地爱着所有女儿，但希望至少有一个王子。他穿一件白色披风，没有胡子，也许有点细细的胡茬。

7102ea3b563d.en: Strengths: adventurous; empathetic; jovial; dynamic; relaxed and friendly with strangers; a teacher, especially about Darfaries and Gandew things; protective of what he holds dear.
7102ea3b563d.t: 优点：爱冒险；有同理心；快活；有活力；对陌生人放松友好；是个好老师，尤其是讲达尔法里斯和甘杜的事；保护他珍视的东西。

72c12d85776c.en: Dalila's family portrait for Arc 2: a gray-haired man, a girl with pink hair (marked with an arrow) and a woman with orange hair.
72c12d85776c.t: 达莉拉第 2 弧的全家福：一个灰发男人、一个粉发女孩（用箭头标出）和一个橙发女人。

72e53cc3f603.en: Gamal: a muscular man with arms crossed, wearing a golden pharaoh-style headdress and a white kilt with a gold belt.
72e53cc3f603.t: 贾迈勒：一个双臂交叉的肌肉男，戴着金色法老式头饰，穿着系金腰带的白色短裙。

736127c819da.en: Fascinated by: Sundeath girls, tidy ones too.
736127c819da.t: 着迷于：桑德斯女孩，也是整洁的那种。

73770e8f0e7e.en: Speech: a cutesy voice, but moody and stingy with her words, and mean when people won't be herded into telling her what she wants. Rarely curses. Under a fake skin, she feels freer to trample over others to get what she wants; she's not very prone to violence, but she can put on a serious face. She likes to think other people's work is slop, and gives people nicknames: Eori is "Dead Stump", Emelia is "Flower Hoe" and Neferteri is "Stuck-up Queen". She doesn't read aloud, but thinks aloud when she's alone; in public she keeps her cool. Often says "tsk", "sheesh", "meh", "argh" and "Damn it!". She reads in short bursts, interspersing the words with her thoughts.
73770e8f0e7e.t: 说话方式：声音很萌，但喜怒无常、惜字如金，当别人不肯被她牵着鼻子走、说出她想听的东西时，她就变得刻薄。很少骂脏话。换上假皮肤后，她觉得可以更自由地践踏别人来得到想要的东西；她不太倾向于使用暴力，但能摆出一张严肃的脸。她喜欢认为别人的工作都是垃圾，还给人起外号：埃奥丽是“死树桩”，艾米莉娅是“花婊子”，奈菲尔特丽是“高傲女王”。她不会念出声来，但独处时会自言自语；在公共场合她保持冷静。常说“啧”“哎哟”“切”“啊啊”和“该死！”。她读东西时一小段一小段地读，在字句之间穿插着自己的想法。

73d2a7abc036.en: Nina (1032 A.G. Asa 80th) is the smallest in size, but her energy more than compensates for it—to the disdain of her mother, Neferteri. There is a chance she might follow after Princess Eori, but people seem to be betting she will turn out to be something closer to Yacamim or Maiara. Hopefully, less Maiara and more Yacamim with Eori's intelligence if you ask a passerby.
73d2a7abc036.t: 妮娜（1032 A.G. 阿萨 80日）个子最小，但她的精力绰绰有余地弥补了这一点——这让她的母亲奈菲尔特丽很是不满。她有可能会追随埃奥丽公主的脚步，但人们似乎在打赌她最终会更像娅卡敏或迈阿拉。如果你问路人，他们会说希望她少像迈阿拉一点，多像娅卡敏一点，再加上埃奥丽的聪明才智。

73e6819e10bf.en: Habits: handsy; friendly; threatening in looks, but not in action.
73e6819e10bf.t: 习惯：爱动手动脚；友好；看起来吓人，但行动上不会。

7402be2f2ff9.t: 缺点：懒惰；粗心；傻；物质主义；贪婪。

7418c7ef09c8.en: Attracted to: stronger, independent women, Darfaries or not.
7418c7ef09c8.t: 喜欢的类型：更强壮、独立的女人，是不是达尔法里斯都行。

74345e8591be.en: Hanako: a woman with green hair in a pink outfit, saluting with one hand.
74345e8591be.t: 花子：一个绿发女子，身穿粉色服装，一只手敬着礼。

755a5568ca01.en: Speech: a lower voice; she doesn't like drawing attention to herself.
755a5568ca01.t: 说话方式：声音较低；她不喜欢引人注目。

756d8dfb8f99.t: 阿米莉娅·托勒里德梅·胡普·阿斯

758ec673e21d.en: Huneo: a short dark-haired young man in a black-and-gold outfit, with a hooded coat shown beside him.
758ec673e21d.t: 胡内奥：一个身材矮小的黑发年轻男子，身穿黑金色服装，身旁画着一件连帽外套。

75b6a64fa998.en: Flaws: shameless; ecchi (she'll play with male genitals without batting an eye); patronizing; compulsive; disruptive.
75b6a64fa998.t: 缺点：不知羞耻；色（她会面不改色地玩弄男性生殖器）；居高临下；冲动；爱搅局。

7684818cc423.en: Born and raised in the Tolerideme Kingdom, to a lower-class family. He always had trouble fattening up, so he became the butt of jokes, even though by other standards he's very handsome. He fled Tolerideme and everyone around him, and stumbled through the world until he ended up in Sweetlake. Much of what he tried never quite worked out because of his personality, and since he couldn't form long-term friendships, people lost trust in him over time.
7684818cc423.t: 在托勒里德梅王国出生长大，出身下层家庭。他一直很难长胖，所以成了别人的笑柄，尽管按别的标准他非常帅。他逃离了托勒里德梅和身边的所有人，在世界上跌跌撞撞，最后来到了斯威特莱克。由于他的性格，他尝试的很多事情都没能成功，而且因为他无法建立长久的友谊，人们渐渐对他失去了信任。

77102fa6cd83.en: Rimir: a man with spiky blond hair and arms crossed, wearing a pink outfit with a red sash.
77102fa6cd83.t: 里米尔：一个头发竖起的金发男人，双臂交叉，穿着系红色腰带的粉色服装。

776a8466e537.en: Intelligence: smart enough to be an assistant, but not the best one around: his mind always drifts back to whatever he deems important, which rarely lines up 100% with his job.
776a8466e537.t: 智力：聪明到足以当个助手，但算不上最好的：他的心思总是飘回他认为重要的事情上，而那很少百分之百和他的工作对得上。

7780dfb06944.en: Amelia (1036 A.G. Adrian 54th) is the contradiction to the statement “the Yabuca never falls far of the tree.” Despite being the second daughter to Kianna, her demeanor is far closer to the likes of introspects and laid-back people like Alford, to the point some have questioned if Amelia is truly Jimmie’s daughter since there was no way Isabel’s soul got in the mix. The soul paternity test has proven that it’s Jimmie’s and Kianna’s daughter. Still, her apathy to social stuff, specifically high-class ones, makes her the odd one out in the family, but not with her friends, of which she has many, including the one and only Nina Sanbi-Royal.
7780dfb06944.t: 阿米莉娅（1036 A.G. 阿德里安 54日）是“亚布卡落地离树不远”这句话的反例。尽管她是琪安娜的第二个女儿，她的举止却更接近像阿尔福德那样内省、随和的人，以至于有人怀疑阿米莉娅是不是真的是吉米的女儿，因为伊莎贝尔的灵魂不可能掺和进来。灵魂亲子鉴定已经证明，她是吉米和琪安娜的女儿。尽管如此，她对社交活动——尤其是上流社会的那些——的冷漠，让她在家里显得格格不入，但在朋友中间却不是这样，她的朋友很多，其中包括独一无二的妮娜·桑比·罗亚尔。

778b66317f4a.en: Habits: sticks close to the people she wants to protect, and be protected by; affectionate, she likes physical closeness with the people she trusts.
778b66317f4a.t: 习惯：紧跟着她想保护、也想被其保护的人；很黏人，喜欢和信任的人有身体上的亲近。

778e99a74e84.en: Her story starts like her twin Katsuki's, but her friendly, spirited nature helped land them both an agent role. That is, until Katsumi truly tasted freedom and decided to flee it all. Now they're locked in a room, hidden from everyone. She hates Arukia and the Red Winga, and tries to escape at every chance she gets, but her pessimistic sister shoots it down every time, especially since Katsumi is the one who got them into this situation in the first place.
778e99a74e84.t: 她的故事和她的双胞胎胜希一开始一样，但她友好、活泼的天性帮两人都谋到了密探的角色。直到胜美真正尝到了自由的滋味，决定抛下一切逃跑。现在她们被锁在一个房间里，藏起来不让任何人看见。她恨阿露琪娅和雷德温加，一有机会就想逃跑，但她悲观的姐妹每次都泼冷水，尤其是因为一开始就是胜美把她们拖进了这个处境。

781d8ad00d93.en: Habits: a creepy smile toward certain people; he can somewhat suppress his body language.
781d8ad00d93.t: 习惯：对某些人露出令人毛骨悚然的笑容；他能在一定程度上压制自己的肢体语言。

794f0cce9bd7.en: Maicon: a grinning gray-haired man in a tan robe with purple trim, pointing.
794f0cce9bd7.t: 迈孔：一个咧嘴笑着、身穿镶紫边的黄褐色长袍的灰发男人，伸手指着。

799ef9d4c0ef.en: Race: human, though he looks like a Darfaries.
799ef9d4c0ef.t: 种族：人类，虽然看起来像达尔法里斯。

7a625826118e.en: Likes and dislikes: loves her family, even Itagiba when he gets drunk: she complains, but by now she accepts it's part of who he is. Loves wine and vegetables in general, and Domar bread is her passion. Her perfume, rose water with notes of wine, is popular in Sundeath. She dislikes anything that interferes with her plans, especially Itagiba getting too drunk during his speeches. Part of her hates the fishy smell all over Sanbi, but she has learned to put up with it.
7a625826118e.t: 喜好与厌恶：爱她的家人，连喝醉的伊塔吉巴也爱：她会抱怨，但如今她已经接受了那是他的一部分。总体上爱葡萄酒和蔬菜，多马尔面包是她的最爱。她的香水是带有葡萄酒香调的玫瑰水，在桑德斯很流行。她讨厌任何干扰她计划的东西，尤其是伊塔吉巴在演讲时喝得太醉。她有一部分讨厌桑比到处弥漫的鱼腥味，但她已经学会了忍受。

7a952ba8293a.en: Strengths: focused; efficient; reliable; self-disciplined; upright; thorough; principled; quick.
7a952ba8293a.t: 优点：专注；高效；可靠；自律；正直；周全；有原则；手脚快。

7acfe2104b31.en: Attracted to: gay, into human and Wozefaries twinks.
7acfe2104b31.t: 喜欢的类型：同性恋，喜欢人类和沃泽法里斯的小鲜肉。

7bc8681d8935.en: Strengths: serious; reserved; meticulous; shy; tidy; dogmatic; orderly.
7bc8681d8935.t: 优点：严肃；内敛；一丝不苟；害羞；整洁；教条；有条理。

7cbcb74dfd11.en: Likes and dislikes: loves experimenting and being in control: from cooking to nari gels, she wants it all. Loves jabbing at Yacamim and Maiara, since both are way too free compared to her. Likes wearing a different belt depending on her mood (or pajamas). Hates how her mother keeps suppressing her for the sake of the kingdom: she wants control over her destiny, but isn't sure how to break free like her sisters. Are they even really free of it all? Who knows.
7cbcb74dfd11.t: 喜好与厌恶：爱做实验，爱掌控一切：从烹饪到纳里凝胶，她什么都想要。爱挖苦娅卡敏和迈阿拉，因为和她比起来，她们俩都太自由了。喜欢根据心情（或者睡衣）换不同的腰带。讨厌母亲为了王国一直压制她：她想掌控自己的命运，却不知道该怎么像她的姐姐们那样挣脱出来。她们真的摆脱了这一切吗？谁知道呢。

7da68a2b0299.en: Left to die as a baby in Flatland City, to unknown parents assumed to be from Sundeath, he was raised by the city among the Sorefaries, and worked his hardest to help the city that raised him: he wanted to repay everyone's help, never wanting to be in anyone's debt. As a teen, he loved a Wozefaries named Asuka, who never loved him back and turned him down in front of everyone. He fled, and decided to get his revenge by becoming the best scientist ever.
7da68a2b0299.t: 他还是婴儿时被丢在弗拉特兰城等死，父母不明，据推测来自桑德斯。他由这座城市在索雷法里斯之间抚养长大，拼尽全力帮助养育了他的城市：他想报答每个人的帮助，从不想欠任何人的情。十几岁时，他爱上了一个叫明日香的沃泽法里斯，她从没爱过他，还当着所有人的面拒绝了他。他逃走了，决定通过成为有史以来最好的科学家来报复。

7e5cba69d051.t: 优点：有创新精神；有创造力；精确；有逻辑；内敛。

7eef0dac109c.en: Alford: a stout smiling farmer in a wide straw hat holding a black rooster and a shovel.
7eef0dac109c.t: 阿尔福德：一个戴着宽边草帽、笑眯眯的矮胖农夫，抱着一只黑公鸡，拿着一把铁锹。

7f5b7a08b3f8.en: Flaws: picky; dogmatic: her principles are the truth, and everyone working under her must follow them or pay the consequences (see the Red Winga); callous; greedy; cold; crafty; deceitful; uses people for her own goals.
7f5b7a08b3f8.t: 缺点：挑剔；教条：她的原则就是真理，在她手下做事的每个人都必须遵守，否则就要承担后果（见雷德温加）；冷酷；贪婪；冷漠；狡诈；欺骗；为了自己的目的利用别人。

7fcbd116e51f.en: Myers-Briggs: ENFP. If a perceived "fake" outer shell now matches the "true" inner self, is the outer shell actually fake, or simply a representation of the truth?
7fcbd116e51f.t: Myers-Briggs：ENFP。如果一层被认为是“假”的外壳如今和“真实”的内在相符，那这层外壳到底是假的，还是只是真相的一种表现？

7fd6fb2d6f29.en: Intelligence: smart in how she uses her skills for adventuring, but lacks emotional intelligence.
7fd6fb2d6f29.t: 智力：在运用冒险技能方面很聪明，但缺乏情商。

80143e2bce7a.en: Melada: a large woman with curly blonde hair in a black dress with many green bead necklaces.
80143e2bce7a.t: 梅拉达：一个留着金色卷发的高大女人，身穿黑色连衣裙，戴着许多串绿色珠子项链。

8057f632914f.en: Fernan (994 A.G. Adrian 6th) was a fairly well-known sapphire adventurer, celebrated for being hands-on in many exploits in keeping the four kingdoms safe. You can still find a statue of him in Tastyleaf after he defended the city from a sudden coordinated attack from awfully intelligent Hifuna beasts. His compassionate tenacity and selfless bravery even inspired many bards and painters, or his handsome looks and charming demeanor had something to do with it—or both likely! Pity that another group of Hifuna beasts claimed his life many years later as he once again selflessly defended his party.
8057f632914f.t: 费尔南（994 A.G. 阿德里安 6日）是一位相当有名的萨菲尔级冒险者，因亲身参与许多保卫四王国安全的冒险而备受赞誉。在他保卫泰斯蒂利夫、抵挡住一群智力高得可怕的希富纳魔兽突然发动的协同攻击之后，你至今仍能在那座城市里找到他的雕像。他富有同情心的坚韧和无私的勇敢甚至激励了许多吟游诗人和画家——又或许和他英俊的外表、迷人的风度有关——很可能两者都有！可惜多年后，当他再一次无私地保护自己的队伍时，另一群希富纳魔兽夺走了他的生命。

8107ed19e03d.en: Francisco: a cheerful bearded man in a pink shirt and patterned shorts, flashing peace signs with both hands.
8107ed19e03d.t: 弗朗西斯科：一个快活的大胡子男人，穿着粉色衬衫和花纹短裤，双手比着剪刀手。

81126df0c83c.en: A simple man with a simple life. His wife died early, and with few resources, he wanted more for his only daughter, Itanema, so he sought an audience with Neferteri, who arranged a better life for Itanema in exchange for Sinoi doing anything she wanted. He doesn't dwell on why he's doing something, and doesn't probe at all: he simply doesn't care. While the real Harry was being experimented on, Sinoi wore Harry's fake skin (the Fake Skin nari gel) and walked around as the Sanbi Eye, representing the kingdom; only Neferteri knew. In Vol 4 he has gone missing: Neferteri suspects a third party, or that he soul-died without anyone noticing, since he's old.
81126df0c83c.t: 一个过着简单生活的简单男人。他的妻子早逝，资源又少，他想给独生女伊塔内玛更多，于是请求觐见奈菲尔特丽，奈菲尔特丽为伊塔内玛安排了更好的生活，条件是西诺伊做她想让他做的任何事。他不纠结自己为什么要做某件事，也完全不打听：他就是不在乎。当真正的哈利被拿去做实验时，西诺伊穿着哈利的假皮肤（费克斯金纳里凝胶），以桑比之眼的身份四处走动，代表王国；只有奈菲尔特丽知道。在第 4 卷中他失踪了：奈菲尔特丽怀疑有第三方插手，或者他年纪大了，在没人注意的情况下灵魂死亡了。

8132b2122067.en: The middle child of parents too busy with the younger kids and work to give him attention. A neighborhood friend talked him into stealing something, and he thought it was pretty cool: money for doing basically nothing (other than stealing). He was barely making ends meet when Clodoveu got in touch and brought him into the Blue Wozens. One day he crossed paths with Fernan and his Black Sapphire colleagues, and tried to steal Fernan's bow. He got his face punched to oblivion and back for it, so he used his memory, and his money, to recreate the bow as closely as he could.
8132b2122067.t: 他是家里的老二，父母忙着照顾更小的孩子和工作，顾不上他。一个邻居朋友怂恿他去偷东西，他觉得这挺酷的：基本上什么都不用干（除了偷）就能拿到钱。就在他勉强糊口的时候，克洛多韦乌联系了他，把他带进了布卢沃增斯。有一天他碰上了费尔南和他的布莱克萨菲尔同僚，想偷费尔南的弓。结果他被一拳打得魂飞魄散又魂归原位，于是他凭着记忆，花了钱，尽可能还原了那把弓。

8166e5ac5ffc.en: Speech: somewhat like Arukia, but not as abusive: more jokey and friendly.
8166e5ac5ffc.t: 说话方式：有点像阿露琪娅，但没那么刻薄：更爱开玩笑，更友好。

81f5a76d7fe7.en: Satomi (949 A.G. Moacir 11th) is the Queen of Gandew and a true Darfaries in spirit because she works hard, cares for her fellow Darfaries, and is as xenophobic as she gets. Perhaps being the only child of the previous king had something to do with it—or something suspicious is going on with her husband always missing one of his tusks.
81f5a76d7fe7.t: 里美（949 A.G. 莫阿西尔 11日）是甘杜的女王，在精神上是一个真正的达尔法里斯，因为她工作努力，关心她的达尔法里斯同胞，而且排外到了极点。也许这和她是前任国王的独生女有关——又或者，她丈夫总是缺一颗獠牙这件事背后有什么可疑之处。

8224ea6efbba.en: Intelligence: average for his species. He doesn't know as much history as you'd expect from a king, so he finds ways to let his wife speak instead.
8224ea6efbba.t: 智力：在他的种族里属于一般水平。他懂的历史不像你对一个国王期待的那么多，所以他会想办法让他妻子代他说话。

8279e3377312.en: Strengths: highly intuitive; direct; perceptive; realistic; fair; impartial; loving toward her sister.
8279e3377312.t: 优点：直觉极强；直接；敏锐；现实；公正；不偏不倚；爱她的姐妹。

82d5ba659925.en: He stumbled into work at a brewery, where Itagiba came over to talk after seeing his crazy setup; one thing led to another, and Gabiro decided to start a new life in the Sanbi Kingdom (he met Itagiba in 1013 A.G. and moved to Sanbi in 1015 A.G.). He became one of the greatest scientists of the past centuries, at the cost of keeping everyone at a distance. He has been researching the soul to recreate that same Wozefaries, Asuka, but with her memories manipulated so that she loves him. He never had a wife or kids, and has no wish to, since there's only one person he loves.
82d5ba659925.t: 他误打误撞进了一家酿酒厂工作，伊塔吉巴看到他那套疯狂的装置后过来和他聊天；一来二去，加比罗决定在桑比王国开始新的生活（他在 1013 A.G. 认识了伊塔吉巴，1015 A.G. 搬到了桑比）。他成了过去几个世纪最伟大的科学家之一，代价是和所有人保持距离。他一直在研究灵魂，想重造那个沃泽法里斯明日香，但要操纵她的记忆，让她爱上他。他从没有过妻子或孩子，也不想要，因为他只爱一个人。

8321f0bfe10a.en: Habits: loving with her family, more neutral with strangers; likes to have her back to a wall, or to be seated, to feel protected.
8321f0bfe10a.t: 习惯：对家人充满爱，对陌生人比较中立；喜欢背靠着墙，或者坐着，好觉得受到保护。

83319cab4825.en: Habits: touchy, and she goes for the balls not long after a chat. She likes to milk them.
83319cab4825.t: 习惯：爱动手动脚，聊不了多久就会去摸蛋蛋。她喜欢把它们榨干。

83f77732a07d.en: Likes and dislikes: likes being with her family and doing things together; her wanderlust isn't as strong as Laramy's. Hates seafood, or anything that tastes fishy: it makes her gag profusely.
83f77732a07d.t: 喜好与厌恶：喜欢和家人在一起，一起做事；她的旅行癖没有拉勒米那么强。讨厌海鲜，或者任何有鱼腥味的东西：会让她干呕不止。

840e89b1304c.en: Speech: gets nasty-mouthed sometimes, especially when someone strays from her plans; otherwise careless and curt. Somehow, an air of elegance surrounds her curt voice.
840e89b1304c.t: 说话方式：有时嘴巴很毒，尤其是有人偏离她的计划时；除此之外漫不经心、言简意赅。不知怎么的，她简短的声音周围总萦绕着一股优雅的气息。

8414f06fe0e5.en: Kianna: a large woman with brown hair in a puffy pink gown and a tall white hat, hand on her chest.
8414f06fe0e5.t: 琪安娜：一个棕发的高大女人，身穿蓬松的粉色长礼服，戴着高高的白帽子，一只手放在胸前。

843578ed4dd4.en: Likes and dislikes: loves beer and fat poontang.
843578ed4dd4.t: 喜好与厌恶：爱啤酒和肥嫩的小穴。

84863981842b.en: Flaws: picky; anxious; boring (to some); too touchy (to some); prying; dwells on the past.
84863981842b.t: 缺点：挑剔；焦虑；（在某些人看来）乏味；（在某些人看来）太爱动手动脚；爱打探；沉湎于过去。

8511fc5713c3.en: She grew up in a family of Domar producers, met Jimmie, and became his second mate for life the second time he lucked out with his spirit recipes.
8511fc5713c3.t: 她在一个多马尔生产商家庭长大，认识了吉米，在他第二次靠烈酒配方走运时，成了他的第二位终身伴侣。

8523dfed9bc0.en: Flaws: pushy; gossipy, sounding jovial while she gossips; intrusive.
8523dfed9bc0.t: 缺点：强势；爱说闲话，说闲话时听起来很快活；爱打探。

85b7cf91af80.en: Eiri (1017 A.G. Asa 10th) was recently voted the new King-maid of Sanbi, taking after her mother, Coema. She tells everyone she will not only fill the big shoes she left behind but also make them much larger for the next King-maid to fill. Easy to say, but being facetious and lewd like her mother is probably just a fraction of the requirements to be a successful King-maid.
85b7cf91af80.t: 艾莉（1017 A.G. 阿萨 10日）最近被选为桑比的新任国王女仆，继承了她母亲科埃玛的衣钵。她告诉每个人，她不仅要接下母亲留下的这个重担，还要把它变得更重，留给下一任国王女仆去担。说起来容易，但像她母亲一样爱开玩笑又好色，大概只是成为一名成功的国王女仆所需条件的一小部分。

86498d730da6.en: Attracted to: gay; he likes really tall, muscly guys, and prefers humans. Earning his own income let him keep it secret, though nobody would care, except Eiri, who pokes fun at him for being so uptight about it.
86498d730da6.t: 喜欢的类型：同性恋；他喜欢非常高、肌肉发达的男人，更喜欢人类。自己挣钱让他得以保守这个秘密，虽然其实没人会在意，除了艾莉，她会取笑他对这件事那么拘谨。

8691ae272b3e.en: Mimi (1024 A.G. Asa 12th) is Hanako's fraternal twin, and even though she lived the same life as her, most people wouldn't believe they are even related unless they look carefully at their shared features. After bounding to Yosuke, she left Flatland and now works at her master's restaurant! It's a popular place in the Forway's southern district. If you do visit it, then don't pay any mind to her zipping around doing random things. Also, don't bother asking her for anything! She will drop whatever she was doing to help you, but then she will forget what she was supposed to do, then go off a random tangent only to get yelled at by Hanako, then cry her heart out in the middle of the restaurant. Meanwhile, the kitchen grinds to a halt because Yosuke has to appear to console her, then scream at you for causing a mess, if not outright kicking you out.
8691ae272b3e.t: 咪咪（1024 A.G. 阿萨 12日）是花子的异卵双胞胎，虽然她和花子过着同样的生活，但除非仔细看她们共同的特征，大多数人都不会相信她们有血缘关系。和洋介结下契约后，她离开了弗拉特兰，如今在师父的餐馆里工作！那是福威南区一家很受欢迎的店。如果你去了，别在意她跑来跑去做些莫名其妙的事。还有，别费心请她帮忙！她会丢下手头的事来帮你，但随后就会忘了自己本来要做什么，接着扯到一个毫不相干的话题上，然后被花子吼，然后在餐馆中央哭得撕心裂肺。与此同时，厨房会陷入停顿，因为洋介不得不出来安慰她，然后冲你大吼大叫，怪你惹了乱子，甚至直接把你赶出去。

86a405270a08.en: Attracted to: cute Wozefaries, on the down low; big, strong Darfaries, officially.
86a405270a08.t: 喜欢的类型：私下里是可爱的沃泽法里斯；官方说法是高大强壮的达尔法里斯。

87302157e180.en: Arukia (1021 A.G. Paulin 11th) came from a village built around a large bridge in the road between Forway & Sanbi Kingdom. Seeking a better life, she struggled her way to the city with the biggest crossroads of them all! She worked her ass off to become someone, eventually making her way to specialized tailor, cooking, and accounting schools which seems impossible on cost alone. Apparently, that wasn't impossible enough as she somehow got top of the class on all three specializations, which few ever accomplished. Eiri Sanbi Royal was so impressed by her that she fought with all the might of her department budget to get such talent as a maid for her kingdom—perhaps with the intention of training her to be the next King-maid. Her shifting personality might seem strange to some, but she always manages to be personable enough to make anyone comfortable around her. Although, don't visit Sanbi castle expecting to taste her cooking, as you won't see her near the kitchen.
87302157e180.t: 阿露琪娅（1021 A.G. 保林 11日）来自福威与桑比王国之间路上一座围绕大桥建起的村子。为了寻求更好的生活，她历尽艰辛来到了拥有最大十字路口的城市！她拼死拼活地努力想出人头地，最终进入了专门的裁缝、烹饪和会计学校——光是学费就似乎是不可能的事。显然，那还不够不可能，因为她不知怎么在全部三个专业中都拿到了第一名，这是极少有人做到过的。艾莉·桑比·罗亚尔对她印象深刻，动用了自己部门预算的全部力量，把这样的人才争取过来为她的王国当女仆——也许是打算把她培养成下一任国王女仆。她多变的性格在一些人看来也许很奇怪，但她总能和蔼可亲到让任何人在她身边都感到自在。不过，别指望去桑比城堡能尝到她的手艺，因为你不会看到她靠近厨房。

873cb9e75538.en: Likes and dislikes: having fun with men; dating; exploring. She doesn't like Takeo, since he found out she was born male.
873cb9e75538.t: 喜好与厌恶：和男人寻欢作乐；约会；探险。她不喜欢武雄，因为他发现了她生来是男性。

882f0150a86b.en: Flaws: intolerant; sometimes speaks her mind a bit too much; flippant; attached and dependent: losing her parents left her depressed for quite a while, since she was so attached to them.
882f0150a86b.t: 缺点：偏狭；有时有点太心直口快；轻率；依恋和依赖：失去父母让她消沉了很长一段时间，因为她太依恋他们了。

88710ba93e65.en: Strengths: outgoing; realistic and pragmatic; doesn't care about others, especially gossip and such; a strong, independent lady who doesn't take shit from anyone.
88710ba93e65.t: 优点：外向；现实而务实；不在乎别人，尤其是八卦之类的；一个坚强、独立、不受任何人鸟气的女人。

88a4098efb82.en: Attracted to: big, well-built, muscular women who treat him like a naughty kid.
88a4098efb82.t: 喜欢的类型：高大、健壮、肌肉发达、把他当成淘气孩子对待的女人。

890a70a5d4a9.en: Maicon (1011 A.G. Adrian 75th) is for sure a frequenter of many illegal establishments catering to peculiar tastes, yet he somehow doesn't like long sandwiches. He must have so much blackmail on him that if revealed, Forway would demand him to be carried so fast to Hifuna that he would be flown over there by guards using Winga nari gels rather than being taken by wagon. But then again, he does have a lot of dirt on people too, so if you ruffle that feather, shit will spread all the way to Newland.
890a70a5d4a9.t: 迈孔（1011 A.G. 阿德里安 75日）肯定是许多迎合特殊癖好的非法场所的常客，但不知为何他并不喜欢长三明治。他身上一定有很多把柄，一旦曝光，福威会要求以最快的速度把他押送到希富纳，快到卫兵会用温加纳里凝胶把他飞过去，而不是用马车运。不过话说回来，他手里也有很多别人的黑料，所以如果你惹毛了他，屎会一路溅到纽兰。

89277f8e78c7.en: Likes and dislikes: loves music, and sings while she works. Likes learning the new job, and some of the drama.
89277f8e78c7.t: 喜好与厌恶：爱音乐，干活时会唱歌。喜欢学习新工作，也喜欢一点八卦。

8956e0de4f35.en: Luny: a woman in a wide flowered hat and work clothes, leaning on a shovel.
8956e0de4f35.t: 露妮：一个戴着宽边花帽、穿着工作服的女人，倚着一把铁锹。

89dae16ad2d4.en: Intelligence: brilliant at everything to do with Soul Energy, especially the soul. But he worries too much about misuse to share his work before it's complete, and besides, he wants to be the first to use it.
89dae16ad2d4.t: 智力：在一切和灵魂能量有关的事情上都很出色，尤其是灵魂。但他太担心被滥用，在研究完成之前不愿分享，而且，他想第一个使用它。

8a12c39572fa.en: Intelligence: above average, but she keeps to herself, or finds ways to get things done without making waves.
8a12c39572fa.t: 智力：高于平均水平，但她不爱出头，或者会想办法在不掀起波澜的情况下把事情办成。

8ae2db184d56.en: Born and raised in Forway City to merchant parents, who sometimes took her on their travels; she fell in love with the countryside, especially Tolerideme. She had a knack for Soul Energy and wanted to become an adventurer, but her parents steered her toward becoming a courtroom scientist instead, enrolling her in the Soul Energy school. So she did, with her sights firmly set on moving to Tolerideme, since an opening would eventually come up there. When she arrived, she met a man so focused on farming that she fell in love with his personality: Alford. They never had children, always too busy with farming and enjoying life.
8ae2db184d56.t: 她在福威城出生长大，父母是商人，有时会带她一起旅行；她爱上了乡村，尤其是托勒里德梅。她有灵魂能量的天赋，想成为冒险者，但她父母引导她去当宫廷科学家，让她进了灵魂能量学校。于是她照做了，并坚定地打算搬到托勒里德梅，因为那里迟早会有空缺。她到了那里后，遇到了一个一心扑在农业上的男人，爱上了他的个性：阿尔福德。他们一直没有孩子，总是忙着种地、享受生活。

8b15e7bb0110.en: Strengths: faithful; loving; kind; liberal; diplomatic; peaceful; intelligent; agreeable; broad-minded; cuddly; wanderlust.
8b15e7bb0110.t: 优点：忠诚；有爱心；善良；开放；有外交手腕；平和；聪明；随和；心胸宽广；黏人；有旅行癖。

8b4597f2da7a.en: Speech: clicks her tongue; sharp, and somewhat rude, putting others down beneath her. Not skilled at conversation.
8b4597f2da7a.t: 说话方式：咂舌；尖刻，有点粗鲁，把别人踩在脚下。不擅长交谈。

8b54aca2a30a.en: Likes and dislikes: loves working; goal-focused. Despite his tone, he helps those in need, but hates anyone who thinks they can take advantage of him or his family. Loves pies.
8b54aca2a30a.t: 喜好与厌恶：热爱工作；以目标为导向。别看他语气那样，他会帮助有需要的人，但痛恨任何以为能占他或他家人便宜的人。爱吃派。

8bd166f5185a.en: Interface: none; he couldn't use the Darfaries interface, since he had no Finaies or Buhraies blood.
8bd166f5185a.t: 界面：无；他用不了达尔法里斯界面，因为他没有菲奈斯或布莱斯的血统。

8c8eb0954df3.en: Clodoveu and the Blue Wozens: three men including a bald man with a mace-wielding friend and a man with a spiked green mohawk holding a bow.
8c8eb0954df3.t: 克洛多韦乌和布卢沃增斯：三个男人，包括一个光头男人、他拿着钉锤的朋友，以及一个留着带尖刺的绿色莫西干头、拿着弓的男人。

8cf55c9fffc3.en: Likes and dislikes: loves a good joke or comment, with no no-go zone for funny remarks. Dislikes anyone being pushy with her maids, or with anyone else; she likes people to have their freedom. Loves fish and being clean, and fruity sweets, especially crunchy finger cakes or anything like them.
8cf55c9fffc3.t: 喜好与厌恶：爱好笑话和俏皮话，搞笑的话题没有禁区。不喜欢有人对她的女仆或任何人强人所难；她希望人们拥有自由。爱吃鱼，爱干净，爱吃果味甜点，尤其是酥脆的手指蛋糕或者任何类似的东西。

8d0ee7ed97e2.en: Likes and dislikes: loves caring for the three children, and helping the business any way she can. Loves Domar recipes and Sanbi fish.
8d0ee7ed97e2.t: 喜好与厌恶：爱照顾三个孩子，尽她所能帮生意。爱多马尔菜谱和桑比的鱼。

8d2a196d098e.en: Speech: straightforward but polite ("We finished the quest. We celebrated. We all spoke our minds. Now it's time for me to say goodbye."), unless he suspects you. Never curses.
8d2a196d098e.t: 说话方式：直接但有礼貌（“我们完成了任务。我们庆祝过了。我们都说出了心里话。现在我该说再见了。”），除非他怀疑你。从不骂脏话。

8e6a23660bd9.en: Habits: makes eye contact, and responds with her hands and head; likes to sit back with a drink and discuss the possibilities.
8e6a23660bd9.t: 习惯：保持眼神接触，用手和头回应；喜欢端着一杯酒往后一靠，讨论各种可能性。

8edabd7473b7.en: Habits: knows how to work her way into people's space when she sees them as a mark, and is cunning in how she approaches them; lots of hand movements, eye contact and smiles.
8edabd7473b7.t: 习惯：当她把某人当作猎物时，知道怎么钻进对方的空间，接近对方的方式很狡猾；手部动作、眼神接触和微笑都很多。

8eeec9e84e70.en: That didn't stop people from seeking them out! Their Lonllow recipes were famous for a secret seasoning that brought tart and salty notes into the traditionally sweet Lonllow flavors. Sometimes it caused indigestion, but the exotic flavors, and a particular enthralling high, were so good that people couldn't help themselves and ignored the side effects. No one ever figured out what they did differently, despite many attempts to reproduce the flavor, from analyzing the end product to abducting a family member and forcing them to talk. They weren't big enough for Forway, or anyone else, to take action against, and they were better known among rich folks chasing exotic food than among common people.
8eeec9e84e70.t: 但这并没有阻止人们去找他们！他们的朗洛菜谱以一种秘制调料而闻名，那种调料给传统上甜的朗洛风味带来了酸和咸的味道。有时它会引起消化不良，但那异国风味，再加上一种特别令人着迷的快感，实在太棒了，人们忍不住，对副作用视而不见。尽管有许多人试图复制那种味道，从分析成品到绑架一个家族成员逼他开口，却没有人弄明白他们到底有什么不同。他们的规模不够大，福威或其他任何人都懒得对他们采取行动，而且他们在追逐异国美食的有钱人中比在普通人中更出名。

8f3fbcd8d60b.en: Intelligence: can't read, but her street smarts, especially at bending men to her will, are really useful.
8f3fbcd8d60b.t: 智力：不识字，但她的街头智慧，尤其是让男人对她言听计从的本事，非常有用。

8f9f06b905c5.en: Attracted to: alpha males; he likes being ordered around. A power bottom.
8f9f06b905c5.t: 喜欢的类型：阿尔法男；他喜欢被人发号施令。一个强势受。

8fc66860589f.en: Strengths: caring; traditional; responsible; sincere; thoughtful; capable; captivating; upright.
8fc66860589f.t: 优点：体贴；传统；有责任心；真诚；深思熟虑；能干；迷人；正直。

8fe9b289bfbd.en: The first of Itagiba and Neferteri's identical twins. She looks a lot like her father: a bit too literally, though. She loves going out exploring and fighting. She's engaged to Hiromi, First Prince of Gandew, after he defeated her in a duel during a brawl between the two at The Dead Wozen tavern, on 1038 A.G. Paulin 98th (Sunnulow). She'll be the next Queen of Sanbi, but for now she's known as the "Manly Princess".
8fe9b289bfbd.t: 伊塔吉巴和奈菲尔特丽的同卵双胞胎中的老大。她长得很像她父亲：不过有点太像了。她爱出去探险、打架。她和甘杜的大王子弘美订了婚，因为 1038 A.G. 保林 98日（Sunnulow），两人在德德沃增酒馆的一场混战中，他在决斗里打败了她。她将成为桑比的下一任王后，但目前人们都叫她“男人婆公主”。

900f04b3a644.en: Habits: points, laughs, throws her hands up. Very physically active, and not afraid to show her raw emotions.
900f04b3a644.t: 习惯：指指点点、哈哈大笑、高举双手。身体非常好动，不怕表露最原始的情绪。

90664aa764ab.en: Likes and dislikes: hates lies; hates suspicion.
90664aa764ab.t: 喜好与厌恶：讨厌谎言；讨厌被怀疑。

9071dccce2aa.en: Likes and dislikes: exploring; a good listener; alcohol; Yacamim, despite her rudeness. Dislikes people who get in his way or mess with what he holds dear.
9071dccce2aa.t: 喜好与厌恶：探险；一个好的倾听者；酒；娅卡敏，尽管她很粗鲁。讨厌挡他路或者碰他珍视之物的人。

907c26d4f9be.en: Strengths: cares for those he considers family; creative; upright; willing; understanding; tolerant; patient; persuasive (he knows how to defuse Marcus and Wilson); gregarious.
907c26d4f9be.t: 优点：关心他视为家人的人；有创造力；正直；肯干；善解人意；宽容；有耐心；有说服力（他知道怎么让马库斯和威尔逊消停下来）；合群。

911379f32698.en: Katsuki (1019 A.G. Asa 80th) is a highly reserved girl, barely talking much with anyone but her sister. However, even with her sister, she does not seem to disclose everything rattling inside her brain, especially after signing a Red Winga contract her sister coerced her to. Although, if she does open her mouth, you might have a hard time decrypting her speech manner, so not like you're gaining much from it anyways.
911379f32698.t: 胜希（1019 A.G. 阿萨 80日）是个非常内向的女孩，除了她姐姐之外几乎不和任何人说话。然而，即使是对姐姐，她似乎也没有把脑子里翻腾的一切都说出来，尤其是在签下姐姐逼她签的雷德温加契约之后。不过，就算她真的开口，你可能也很难解读她的说话方式，所以反正你也得不到多少东西。

914a13f564cc.en: Speech: likes to poke and probe; eats while talking; known for invading personal space; likes to say "Exactly!" and "Yeah! Exactly!"; a breathy voice.
914a13f564cc.t: 说话方式：喜欢戳戳探探；边吃边说话；以侵犯个人空间出名；爱说“没错！”和“对！没错！”；说话带着气声。

91daff278c89.en: Marcos and the Blue Wozens: a bald man in a brown coat (marked with an arrow), a shirtless man with a mace and a man with a spiked mohawk holding a bow.
91daff278c89.t: 马科斯和布卢沃增斯：一个穿棕色外套的光头男人（用箭头标出）、一个拿着钉锤的赤膊男人，以及一个留着带尖刺的莫西干头、拿着弓的男人。

91db6dfc4505.en: Strengths: liberal; pioneering; sympathetic; dynamic; friendly; quick-witted, especially at talking her and her sister out of trouble; positive; stoic.
91db6dfc4505.t: 优点：开放；开拓进取；富有同情心；有活力；友好；反应快，尤其是在帮自己和姐妹脱身的时候；积极；坚忍。

92506ad7ccd8.en: Flaws: crafty; fixed; calculating; uncharitable; attached to her birthplace, and doesn't like to travel.
92506ad7ccd8.t: 缺点：狡诈；固执；工于心计；不厚道；依恋出生地，不喜欢旅行。

926582abab1a.en: Strengths: playful; friendly; enthusiastic; fearless, except with his wife; inventive; relaxed; discreet; sympathetic; not stuck in tradition, yet resolute in helping Gandew and its people, even those kicked down the mountain; helpful; communist.
926582abab1a.t: 优点：俏皮；友好；热情；无所畏惧，除了在他妻子面前；有创造力；放松；谨慎；富有同情心；不拘泥于传统，却坚定地帮助甘杜和它的人民，甚至是那些被踢下山的人；乐于助人；共产主义者。

926814da95f1.en: Kiko (1018 A.G. Adrian 37th) is an entrepreneur known for founding the Half-cruro and bringing it from nothing into one of the biggest, at least in terms of raw size, guilds in the Sanbi kingdom. Some have accused his guild contracts of violating The Prosperity Treaty Section #4 Sub 1 & 3 for making the contract lopsided in benefitting the guild. However, Forway officials have stated that the fact it grants a pathway for Cruros to flee the tribes and become proper kingdom citizens is a fair exchange for lifelong servitude at cheap rates.
926814da95f1.t: 基科（1018 A.G. 阿德里安 37日）是一位企业家，以创立哈夫·克鲁罗公会并把它从无到有发展成桑比王国最大的公会之一（至少就纯规模而言）而闻名。有人指控他的公会契约违反了《繁荣条约》第 4 条第 1 款和第 3 款，因为契约内容一边倒地对公会有利。然而，福威官员表示，契约为克鲁罗提供了一条逃离部落、成为真正王国公民的途径，用廉价的终身劳役来交换是公平的。

932e4c97a821.en: Harry’s journey will be grueling, but he will not be swept by the challenging winds the more he roots himself in the new world. But will he face the challenge and make meaningful, trustworthy connections?
932e4c97a821.t: 哈利的旅程将会十分艰辛，但他在新世界扎根越深，就越不会被逆风卷走。但他能否迎接挑战，建立起有意义、值得信赖的关系呢？

93379cad7d26.en: Akemi: a young woman with long blue hair in a red sleeveless dress, holding a book, on a height chart.
93379cad7d26.t: 明美：一位留着蓝色长发、身穿红色无袖连衣裙的年轻女子，手里拿着一本书，画在身高对比图上。

93f6167db911.en: Strengths: responsible; sincere; analytical; hardworking; trustworthy; disciplined; persistent; rational; mature.
93f6167db911.t: 优点：有责任心；真诚；善于分析；勤劳；值得信赖；自律；坚持不懈；理性；成熟。

944917073bf7.en: Strengths: stable; strong; mature; independent; generous, investing in adventurers; resourceful; a delegator; persuasive, sometimes a bit much.
944917073bf7.t: 优点：稳重；坚强；成熟；独立；慷慨，愿意投资冒险者；足智多谋；善于分派任务；有说服力，有时有点过头。

948650b045b6.en: Attracted to: women, especially strong-looking ones, so her partners are usually Darfaries women. She has a thing for Arukia, too.
948650b045b6.t: 喜欢的类型：女人，尤其是看起来强壮的，所以她的伴侣通常是达尔法里斯女人。她对阿露琪娅也有意思。

94dd6ff5274a.en: Habits: furrows his brow; scratches his beard or belly; joins conversations and asks questions. He doesn't depend on Nari stones as much, thanks to his high recharge rate, but he can't use the Darfaries interface. In Vol 4 he shows, for the first time, an interface of his own that turns Soul Energy into fire from the tips of his middle and ring fingers.
94dd6ff5274a.t: 习惯：皱眉；挠胡子或肚子；加入谈话、问问题。由于充能速度快，他不那么依赖纳里石，但他用不了达尔法里斯界面。在第 4 卷中，他第一次展现出属于他自己的界面，能把灵魂能量从中指和无名指的指尖变成火焰。

95e248005352.en: Habits: keeps eye contact, with rhythmic blinking and a mostly still posture, almost robotic. When he snaps out of it, he furiously writes Vraki words in his book. (Real-world comparison: Eucliwood Hellscythe, from the anime Is This a Zombie?, who also speaks mostly through writing.) He's rarely seen making grunts.
95e248005352.t: 习惯：保持眼神接触，有节奏地眨眼，姿势大多一动不动，几乎像个机器人。回过神来时，他会在本子上飞快地写弗拉基文字。（现实世界的对照：动画Is This a Zombie?里的尤克莉伍德·海尔赛兹（Eucliwood Hellscythe），她也主要靠写字说话。）很少看到他发出咕噜声。

9618ced4df1d.t: 生日：993 A.G. 阿萨 64日（她 26 岁时生了玛姬）。

9670bdd2bb22.en: His mother is from Tolerideme and his father from Gandew, and they had him in Freeish (in Big-Gyut), so he grew up with three cultures, and made his own mix of what he decided was best for him. He had a fundamental education, but his constant daydreaming kept him job-hopping, stuck as an apprentice. His parents kicked him out to see the world and maybe mature a bit. He went hungry fast, and that's when Kozaku noticed him and brought him into the Blue Wozens. His daydreaming means he's basically just a body on the team, rather than someone who brings in lots of loot.
9670bdd2bb22.t: 他母亲来自托勒里德梅，父亲来自甘杜，他们在弗里伊什（比格久特）生下了他，所以他在三种文化中长大，并把他认为对自己最好的东西混合成了自己的一套。他受过基础教育，但总是做白日梦，让他不停地换工作，一直当学徒。他的父母把他赶出家门去见见世面，也许能成熟一点。他很快就饿肚子了，就在那时小作注意到了他，把他带进了布卢沃增斯。因为爱做白日梦，他在队里基本上只是凑个人头，而不是带回大量战利品的人。

9691f756d8e6.en: Habits: moves his hands; pauses to think, still as a stone until his mind is resolute and absolute about what to say.
9691f756d8e6.t: 习惯：会动手；停下来思考，像石头一样一动不动，直到他心里对要说的话坚定、确信为止。

96e215b42840.en: Likes and dislikes: loves seafood, meat and anything else that ever walked this earth. Doesn't care much for vegetables or fruit.
96e215b42840.t: 喜好与厌恶：爱吃海鲜、肉和任何在这片土地上走过的东西。不太在乎蔬菜和水果。

96e5819c8a21.en: Her abilities weren't quite up to expectations, but her manipulation skills got her through school at the top of her class. Still early in her career, Eiri saw her and hired her on the spot as a near-perfect maid for Sanbi: Eiri found and hired her on 1038 A.G. Asa 77th, and on Asa 83rd Arukia stopped at her parents' place to sleep on the way to the Sanbi Kingdom. It turned out to be a bit more complicated than that, but oh well.
96e5819c8a21.t: 她的能力并没有完全达到预期，但她操纵人的本事让她以全班第一的成绩毕了业。在她职业生涯的早期，艾莉看到了她，当场就雇她做了桑比一名近乎完美的女仆：艾莉在 1038 A.G. 阿萨 77日发现并雇用了她，阿萨 83日，阿露琪娅在前往桑比王国的路上在父母家停下来过夜。后来发现事情比这要复杂一点，不过算了。

971e9245e502.en: Fascinated by: handsome boys, or big, imposing ones: fat versions of a prince.
971e9245e502.t: 着迷于：帅气的男孩，或者高大威猛的男孩：胖版的王子。

975b2400ae76.en: Strengths: conscientious; empathetic; romantic; willing; independent; a busybody.
975b2400ae76.t: 优点：尽责；有同理心；浪漫；肯干；独立；爱管闲事。

98ec5de873ef.en: Attracted to: money. If there's a large penis attached to the money bag, then sure, whatever.
98ec5de873ef.t: 喜欢的类型：钱。如果钱袋上连着一根大鸡巴，那也行，无所谓。

99367992f994.en: Flaws: intrusive; nosy about the drama; sassy.
99367992f994.t: 缺点：爱打探；爱打听八卦；嘴贫。

99c6c4d34935.en: Intelligence: her parents taught her to read. She has a simple mindset, and her knowledge leans toward woodcarving.
99c6c4d34935.t: 智力：她父母教她识字。她思维简单，知识偏向木雕。

9a321d7c2880.en: Kiko: a lizard-like half-Cruro with a spiky green crest, wearing a long red coat.
9a321d7c2880.t: 基科：一个长着带尖刺的绿色头冠、身穿红色长外套的蜥蜴般的半克鲁罗。

9a39571c0786.en: Yosuke: a bald man in a pink outfit holding a long two-pronged tool, shown enlarged in a speech bubble.
9a39571c0786.t: 洋介：一个穿着粉色服装的光头男人，拿着一把长长的双齿工具，在对话框里被放大显示。

9ac8eb2694d6.en: Morika in Arcs 2 to 4: a blond young man shown shirtless in dark trousers and in full silver-and-gold armor with a sword.
9ac8eb2694d6.t: 第 2 至 4 弧的莫里卡：一个金发年轻男子，分别画出了赤裸上身穿深色长裤的样子，以及身穿全套银金色盔甲、手持长剑的样子。

9b0934cf0198.en: Likes and dislikes: likes spirits and strong liquors, especially fruity ones, and refined cheeses, meats and the like. Hates fish, even the smell of it.
9b0934cf0198.t: 喜好与厌恶：喜欢烈酒，尤其是果味的，还有精致的奶酪、肉类之类的东西。讨厌鱼，连鱼腥味都讨厌。

9b1337884f33.en: Flaws: makes everything about himself; grandiose; narcissistic, and lashes out if you mess with his looks; vain; superficial; moody; condemnatory; insecure; jealous.
9b1337884f33.t: 缺点：什么都以自己为中心；夸夸其谈；自恋，你要是动他的外表他就会发飙；虚荣；肤浅；喜怒无常；爱谴责人；没有安全感；爱嫉妒。

9b6ccc644e06.t: 第 9 任法老，奈菲尔特丽的父亲。

9bf8142446c0.en: Born in Sanbi on 1017 A.G. Asa 10th and raised there by parents with a Tier III profession: her mother, Coema, was the King-maid before her. She loved helping in the kitchen and decided to become a chef (1028 A.G.). At school, she took a few off-the-clock "cooking lessons" on how to warm up boys' sausages, and one of the boys was an accountant: she fell in love with accounting instead of the boy, and graduated in both (1036 A.G.). Coema knew she would grow into the role of King-maid and gave her a chance as a maid (1036 A.G.). Thanks to her outstanding knowledge, looks and playfulness, Coema promoted her to King-maid on 1038 A.G. Asa 9th, the day before her birthday. On 1038 A.G. Asa 77th, passing through Forway, she found Arukia and hired her at the drop of a hat.
9bf8142446c0.t: 1017 A.G. 阿萨 10日生于桑比，在那里由从事 III 级职业的父母抚养长大：她母亲科埃玛是她之前的国王女仆。她喜欢在厨房帮忙，决定当一名厨师（1028 A.G.）。在学校里，她上了几节课外的“烹饪课”，学怎么给男孩们热香肠，其中一个男孩是会计：她爱上的不是那个男孩而是会计，最后两门都毕了业（1036 A.G.）。科埃玛知道她会逐渐胜任国王女仆这个角色，给了她一个当女仆的机会（1036 A.G.）。凭借出色的学识、外貌和俏皮，科埃玛在 1038 A.G. 阿萨 9日，也就是她生日的前一天，把她提拔为国王女仆。1038 A.G. 阿萨 77日，她路过福威时发现了阿露琪娅，二话不说就雇用了她。

9c4054841de9.en: He has worked closely with the Sanbi Royals a great deal. He's the one who got Harry's badge for Itagiba, without knowing the details: all he knew was that a random hobo had been revived and needed a badge for the competition the next morning, and since he trusted Itagiba, he didn't require Harry to be present at the embassy. Very direct: he doesn't hesitate and doesn't back down. He has a quid pro quo contract with Neferteri: he gives her information, and she's bound to back his rise through the ranks, give him the information he asks for, and nudge the kingdoms with voting power to make him Sapphire General. His daughter is Lofingha.
9c4054841de9.t: 他和桑比王室密切合作过很多次。正是他为伊塔吉巴弄到了哈利的身份牌，却不知道其中的细节：他只知道有个流浪汉被复活了，第二天早上的比赛需要一个身份牌，而且因为他信任伊塔吉巴，他没有要求哈利本人到大使馆来。非常直接：他不犹豫，也不退缩。他和奈菲尔特丽有一份互惠合同：他给她情报，而她有义务支持他晋升，给他他要的情报，并用投票权推动各王国让他成为萨菲尔将军。他的女儿是洛芬嘉。

9c5c47389dd9.en: When she was a kid, her mother seemed to be a lazy, uncaring Darfaries, the woman her father, Lofinghy, had fallen in love with. They clashed more and more until things couldn't work anymore, and they separated. She took it to heart and set out to root out laziness in people, and she'll fight to make it happen, even if it pushes people away in the end. She cares about her people and her kingdom.
9c5c47389dd9.t: 她小时候，她母亲似乎是个懒惰、冷漠的达尔法里斯，就是她父亲洛芬吉爱上的那个女人。他们的冲突越来越多，直到再也过不下去，于是分开了。她把这件事放在了心上，立志要根除人们身上的懒惰，并且会为此奋斗到底，哪怕最后把人都推开。她关心她的人民和她的王国。

9d8904f2d544.en: Habits: likes to sit alone and think, keeping her hands busy, usually adjusting her bracelets as she ponders. She doesn't wear sleeves, and wears metal rings.
9d8904f2d544.t: 习惯：喜欢独自坐着思考，手里不闲着，通常是一边沉思一边调整她的手镯。她不穿袖子，戴着金属戒指。

9dc3a410ca6a.en: Intelligence: emotionally intelligent, but that's about it.

9e1b945a9bdf.en: Laramy (986 A.G. Paulin 34th) is a trader born north of Tolerideme in a village called Broken-tree. However, as soon as he was out of the uterus, he was in a wagon traveling around with his merchant parents. The merchant life led him to make friends across the four kingdoms, with some definitely using that friendship to make one-sided trades against him. He doesn't seem to pay much mind to it as he seems to enjoy that life more for the strong wanderlust he developed rather than purely for money. His wife and daughter also picked up the wanderlust, so you will never see them anywhere for more than a week, even at their physical address, which is just a bedroom at Melada's house—Laramy's cousin.
9e1b945a9bdf.t: 拉勒米（986 A.G. 保林 34日）是一位商人，出生在托勒里德梅以北一个叫布罗肯·特里的村子。然而，他一离开子宫，就坐上马车跟着当商人的父母到处旅行。商人生活让他在四王国交到了朋友，其中有些人肯定利用这份友谊和他做了一边倒的交易。他似乎不太在意，因为他享受这种生活，更多是因为他养成的强烈漫游癖，而不纯粹是为了钱。他的妻子和女儿也染上了漫游癖，所以你永远不会看到她们在任何地方待超过一个星期，甚至在她们的实际住址也是如此——那只是拉勒米表亲梅拉达家里的一间卧室。

9e47ddcc1e0d.en: Flaws: protective; judgmental, since he's idealistic to a fault; tense; demanding; punishing.
9e47ddcc1e0d.t: 缺点：保护欲强；爱评判，因为他理想主义到了过分的地步；紧绷；要求苛刻；爱惩罚人。

9e757169ec46.en: A big, tough-looking and intelligent Cruro who fled Cruroland for a new life. Forway culture seeped into him, and with his drive, he made a fortune with other Cruros when he founded the Half-Cruro guild. His friend Coema helped the guild shine. (His name follows the Name Schema: Sanbi, his place, and Half-Cruro, his guild.)
9e757169ec46.t: 一只高大、看起来很强悍、又聪明的克鲁罗，为了新生活逃离了克鲁罗兰。福威的文化渗透进了他身上，凭着他的干劲，他创立了哈夫克鲁罗公会，和其他克鲁罗一起发了财。他的朋友科埃玛帮助公会大放异彩。（他的名字遵循命名规则：桑比是他的地点，哈夫克鲁罗是他的公会。）

9ea606f157ff.en: Takeo: a tall man in brown leather armor holding a large axe and a helmet, with a teacup charm.
9ea606f157ff.t: 武雄：一个身穿棕色皮甲的高个男子，手持一把大斧和一顶头盔，挂着一个茶杯护符。

9fc370f64823.en: Kianna (1004 A.G. Asa 14th) is a Toleridemian through and through, except when it comes to her apparent greed and exuberance that rivals the most high society from Forway. Her power grew vast once she became Jimmie’s first partner by giving birth to Ariana, a spitting image of herself, down to the ambition of being atop it all and the willingness to step on everyone and everything on her way to get there. Nobody is perfect, though, and it is commonly known that if you stroke her ego just right, you can make her gullible to pretty much any business deal, even shitty ones!
9fc370f64823.t: 琪安娜（1004 A.G. 阿萨 14日）是个彻头彻尾的托勒里德梅人，只是她那显而易见的贪婪和奢华，堪比福威最上流的社会。她通过生下阿丽亚娜成为吉米的第一位伴侣后，权力大大增长；阿丽亚娜就是她的翻版，连那份想要凌驾于一切之上的野心、以及为了达到目的不惜踩着所有人和一切往上爬的意愿都一样。不过人无完人，众所周知，只要恰到好处地拍她的马屁，你就能让她轻信几乎任何生意，哪怕是烂透了的那种！

a06d9b1980d6.en: A happy accident one night ;). Unlike all the other girls, she's pure sweetness: she got the good stuff from both parents, though greed took over a bit.
a06d9b1980d6.t: 某天晚上的一个美丽意外 ;)。和其他所有女孩不同，她是纯粹的甜美：她从父母双方都继承了好的东西，不过贪心稍微占了上风。

a09a70d2bb54.en: Likes and dislikes: likes harmony. Really likes putting food on twinks' bodies and licking it off.
a09a70d2bb54.t: 喜好与厌恶：喜欢和谐。特别喜欢把食物放在小鲜肉的身上再舔掉。

a10786872332.en: Strengths: intelligent; helpful; disciplined; punctual; hardworking; motivating.
a10786872332.t: 优点：聪明；乐于助人；自律；守时；勤劳；能激励人。

a115c32b8bb5.en: Intelligence: average. Nothing special, other than finding ways to be lazy.
a115c32b8bb5.t: 智力：一般。没什么特别的，除了想办法偷懒。

a1a10cdc590d.en: Speech: curses; asks questions, but gives up as soon as his mind catches up and works out the answer; choice words. Hates repeating himself.
a1a10cdc590d.t: 说话方式：骂脏话；会提问，但一旦脑子跟上、想出了答案就不问了；措辞讲究。讨厌重复自己的话。

a1cedb74eaed.t: 喜欢的类型：总体来说是强悍的女人。

a234280f422b.en: Speech: a fatherly tone; clear-cut; a bold voice with a demanding, almost commanding tone. Clears his throat often, especially when he's annoyed.
a234280f422b.t: 说话方式：父亲般的语气；干脆利落；声音洪亮，语气苛刻，几乎是命令式的。常常清嗓子，尤其是烦躁的时候。
